Abi Thabit, the same, except that he said: “dannat wa-idtarabat” [wording obscure; apparently describing the camel's breeding/the dispute over her].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ طَارِقًا، قَضَى ⦗ص: 219⦘ بِالْمَدِينَةِ بِالْعُمْرَى عَنْ قَوْلِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Sulayman b. Yasar, that
entries.matn_en: Tariq ruled [p. 219] in Medina on the 'umra based on the statement of Jabir b. 'Abd Allah from the Prophet ﷺ.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ حُجْرٍ الْمَدَرِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَعَلَ الْعُمْرَى لِلْوَارِثِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr, from Tawus, from Hujr al-Madari, from Zayd b. Thabit ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ made the 'umra [belong] to the heir.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تُعْمِرُوا، وَلَا تُرْقِبُوا، فَمَنْ أُعْمِرَ شَيْئًا أَوْ أُرْقِبَهُ فَهُوَ سَبِيلُ الْمِيرَاثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', from Jabir ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not give 'umra and do not give ruqba; whoever is given something as 'umra or ruqba, it follows the course of inheritance.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ، هَرَبَ مِنَ الْإِسْلَامِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَشَهِدَ حُنَيْنًا وَالطَّائِفَ مُشْرِكًا، وَامْرَأَتُهُ مَسْلَمَةٌ، وَاسْتَقَرَّ عَلَى النِّكَاحِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: وَكَانَ بَيْنَ إِسْلَامِ صَفْوَانَ وَامْرَأَتِهِ نَحْوٌ مِنْ شَهْرٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, that
entries.matn_en: Safwan b. Umayya fled from Islam, then came to the Prophet ﷺ and witnessed Hunayn and al-Ta'if as a polytheist while his wife was a Muslim, and the marriage remained in place. Ibn Shihab said: Between the conversion of Safwan and that of his wife there was about a month.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تَبِيعُوا الذَّهَبَ بِالذَّهَبِ إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَلَا تُشِفُّوا بَعْضَهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَلَا تَبِيعُوا الْوَرِقَ بِالْوَرِقِ إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَلَا تُشِفُّوا بَعْضَهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that 'Umar ﵁ said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not sell gold for gold except like for like, and do not give extra of one over the other; and do not sell silver for silver except like for like, and do not give extra of one over the other.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْمُتَبَايِعَانِ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِالْخِيَارِ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا إِلَّا بَيْعَ الْخِيَارِ» قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رضي الله عنه: وَابْنُ عُمَرَ الَّذِي سَمِعَهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا ابْتَاعَ الشَّيْءَ يُعْجِبُهُ أَنْ يَجِبَ لَهُ فَارَقَ صَاحِبَهُ فَمَشَى قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ أَخْبَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ، سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The two parties to a sale each have the option against the other so long as they have not separated, except for a sale with an option.” Al-Shafi'i ﵁ said: And Ibn 'Umar, who heard it from the Prophet ﷺ, when he bought something and wished it to be final for him, would part from his counterpart, walk a little, and then return. Sufyan informed us of that, from Ibn Jurayj, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، وَعَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 220⦘ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُلَامَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Muhammad b. Yahya b. Habban, and from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from [p. 220] Abu Hurayra ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade mulamasa and munabadha [sales concluded by touching or throwing the item].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ قَالَ مَالِكٌ رضي الله عنه: وَإِنَّمَا كُرِهَ بَيْعُ الْكِلَابِ الضَّوَارِي وَغَيْرِ الضَّوَارِي لِنَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham, from Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ forbade the price of a dog, the earnings of a prostitute, and the fee of a soothsayer. Malik ﵁ said: The sale of dogs, whether trained for hunting or not, is disliked because of the Prophet's ﷺ prohibition of the price of a dog.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْأَيِّمُ أَحَقُّ بِنَفْسِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا، وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْذَنُ فِي نَفْسِهَا، وَإِذْنُهَا صُمَاتُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Fadl, from Nafi' b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas ﵄, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “A woman without a husband (ayyim) has more right over herself than her guardian, and a virgin is asked for her permission concerning herself, and her permission is her silence.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ نُكِحَتْ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ وَلِيِّهَا فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ». ثَلَاثًا
entries.isnad_en: Muslim and 'Abd al-Majid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Sulayman b. Musa, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha ﵂, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Any woman who is married without the permission of her guardian, her marriage is void”—three times.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا نِكَاحَ إِلَّا بِوَلِيٍّ مُرْشِدٍ وَشَاهِدَيْ عَدْلٍ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim informed us, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas ﵄, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no marriage except with a guardian of sound judgment and two upright witnesses.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ سَهْلَةَ بِنْتَ سُهَيْلٍ أَنْ تُرْضِعَ سَالِمًا خَمْسَ رَضَعَاتٍ، فَتَحْرُمَ بِهِنَّ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ commanded Sahla bint Suhayl to nurse Salim five times, so that he would become unlawful [for marriage] to her through them.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ فِيمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ عَشْرُ رَضَعَاتٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ يُحَرِّمْنَ، ثُمَّ نُسِخْنَ بِخَمْسٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ، فَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يُقْرَأُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr b. Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Hazm, from 'Amra bint 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'A'isha, Mother of the Believers ﵂, that she said:
entries.matn_en: “Among what God revealed in the Qur'an was: ‘Ten known sucklings make [marriage] unlawful,’ then they were abrogated by ‘five known [sucklings],’ and the Messenger of God ﷺ died while they were among what is recited of the Qur'an.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْسَلَتْ بِهِ وَهُوَ يَرْضَعُ إِلَى أُخْتِهَا أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ فَأَرْضَعَتْهُ ثَلَاثَ رَضَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ مَرِضَتْ فَلَمْ تُرْضِعْهُ غَيْرَ ثَلَاثِ رَضَعَاتٍ، فَلَمْ أَكُنْ أَدْخُلُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ لَمْ تَكْمُلْ لِي عَشْرَ رَضَعَاتٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', that Salim b. 'Abd Allah informed him that
entries.matn_en: 'A'isha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, sent him while he was nursing to her sister Umm Kulthum, who nursed him three times, then fell ill and nursed him no more than those three. [Salim said:] “So I did not enter upon 'A'isha, because Umm Kulthum had not completed ten sucklings for me.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ حَفْصَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رضي الله عنها أَرْسَلَتْ بِعَاصِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ إِلَى أُخْتِهَا فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ عُمَرَ تُرْضِعُهُ عَشْرَ رَضَعَاتٍ لِيَدْخُلَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُوَ صَغِيرٌ يَرْضَعُ، فَفَعَلَتْ فَكَانَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Safiyya bint Abi 'Ubayd, that she informed him that
entries.matn_en: Hafsa, Mother of the Believers ﵂, sent 'Asim b. 'Abd Allah b. Sa'd to her sister Fatima bint 'Umar to nurse him ten times so that he could enter upon her while he was a small nursing child. She did so, and he used to enter upon her.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تُحَرِّمُ الْمَصَّةُ وَلَا الْمَصَّتَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Anas b. 'Iyad informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr ﵁, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “One suck or two sucks do not make [marriage] unlawful.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّمَا الْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'A'isha ﵂, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Wala' belongs only to the one who frees.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the sale of wala' and its gifting.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ: «اعْرِفْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلَّا فَشَأْنَكَ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Rabi'a b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Yazid, client of al-Munba'ith, from Zayd b. Khalid al-Juhani, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and asked him about lost property (luqata). He said: “Note its container and its tie, then announce it for a year; if its owner comes [return it], otherwise it is yours to deal with.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَدْرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ، نَزَلَ مَنْزِلَ قَوْمٍ بِطَرِيقِ الشَّامِ فَوَجَدَ صُرَّةً فِيهَا ثَمَانُونَ دِينَارًا، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ ⦗ص: 222⦘ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «عَرِّفْهَا عَلَى أَبْوَابِ الْمَسَاجِدِ، وَاذْكُرْهَا لِمَنْ يَقْدُمُ مِنَ الشَّامِ سَنَةً، فَإِذَا مَضَتِ السَّنَةُ فَشَأْنَكَ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ayyub b. Musa, from Mu'awiya b. 'Abd Allah b. Badr, that his father informed him that
entries.matn_en: he stopped at the camp of some people on the road to Syria and found a purse containing eighty dinars. He mentioned that [p. 222] to 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and 'Umar ﵁ said to him: “Announce it at the doors of the mosques, and mention it to those who come from Syria, for a year. When the year has passed, it is yours to deal with.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، وَجَدَ لُقَطَةً فَجَاءَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي وَجَدْتُ لُقَطَةً فَمَاذَا تَرَى؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: " عَرِّفْهَا، قَالَ: قَدْ فَعَلْتُ، قَالَ: زِدْ، قَالَ: قَدْ فَعَلْتُ، قَالَ: لَا آمُرُكَ أَنْ تَأْكُلَهَا، وَلَوْ شِئْتَ لَمْ تَأْخُذْهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', that
entries.matn_en: a man found a lost item and came to 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar and said: “I found a lost item; what do you think?” Ibn 'Umar said: “Announce it.” He said: “I have.” He said: “Do more.” He said: “I have.” He said: “I do not command you to eat it; and had you wished, you would not have taken it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ هُوَ مِنْ وَلَدِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَهَبَ لِحَاجَتِهِ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ وَصَلَّى
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Abbad b. Ziyad, one of the descendants of al-Mughira b. Shu'ba, from al-Mughira ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ went to relieve himself during the campaign of Tabuk, then performed ablution, wiped over his leather socks, and prayed.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُمَا أَخْبَرَاهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ قَدِمَ الْكُوفَةَ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَهُوَ أَمِيرُهَا، فَرَآهُ يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعْدٌ: سَلْ أَبَاكَ، فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «إِذَا أَدْخَلْتَ رِجْلَيْكَ فِي الْخُفَّيْنِ وَهُمَا طَاهِرَتَانِ فَامْسَحْ عَلَيْهِمَا». قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: وَإِنْ جَاءَ أَحَدُنَا مِنَ الْغَائِطِ؟ فَقَالَ: وَإِنْ جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi' and 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, who both informed him that
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar came to Kufa to Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who was its governor, and saw him wiping over his leather socks. 'Abd Allah objected to that, and Sa'd said to him: “Ask your father.” He asked him, and 'Umar ﵁ said: “When you put your feet into the leather socks while they are clean, wipe over them.” Ibn 'Umar said: “Even if one of us has come from relieving himself?” He said: “Even if one of you has come from relieving himself.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، بَالَ بِالسُّوقِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', that
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar urinated in the marketplace, then performed ablution, wiped over his leather socks, and prayed.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رُقَيْشٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رَأَيْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَتَى قُبَاءً فَبَالَ وَتَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ruqaysh, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I saw Anas b. Malik come to Quba', urinate, perform ablution, wipe over his leather socks, and then pray.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِلْيَهُودِ حِينَ افْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ: «أُقِرُّكُمْ مَا أَقَرَّكُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَى أَنَّ التَّمْرَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ». فَكَانَ ⦗ص: 223⦘ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَبْعَثُ ابْنَ رَوَاحَةَ فَيَخْرُصُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «إِنْ شِئْتُمْ فَلَكُمْ، وَإِنْ شِئْتُمْ فَلِي»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Ibn al-Musayyab, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said to the Jews when he conquered Khaybar: “I will keep you as long as God keeps you, on condition that the dates are shared between us and you.” [p. 223] The Messenger of God ﷺ would send Ibn Rawaha, who would estimate the crop between him and them, then say: “If you wish, it is yours [at that estimate], and if you wish, it is mine.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ حُنَيْنٍ فَلَمَّا الْتَقَيْنَا كَانَتْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ جَوْلَةٌ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَدْ عَلَا رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، قَالَ: فَاسْتَدَرْتُ لَهُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ فَضَرَبْتُهُ عَلَى حَبْلِ عَاتِقِهِ ضَرْبَةً فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ فَضَمَّنِي ضَمَّةً وَجَدْتُ مِنْهَا رِيحَ الْمَوْتِ، ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَأَرْسَلَنِي، فَلَحِقْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: مَا بَالُ النَّاسِ؟ قَالَ: أَمْرُ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّاسَ رَجَعُوا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلًا لَهُ عَلَيْهِ بَيِّنَةٌ فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ». فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لِي؟ ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ، فَقَالَهَا الثَّانِيَةَ، فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ يَشْهَدُ لِي؟ ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ، فَقَالَهَا الثَّالِثَةَ، فَقُمْتُ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا لَكَ يَا أَبَا قَتَادَةَ؟» فَاقْتَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْقِصَّةَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ: صَدَقَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَسَلَبُ ذَلِكَ الْقَتِيلِ عِنْدِي، فَأَرْضِهِ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: لَاهَا اللَّهِ إِذًا، لَا يَعْمِدُ إِلَى أَسَدٍ مِنْ أُسْدِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى يُقَاتِلُ عَنِ اللَّهِ فَيُعْطِيَكَ سَلَبَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «صَدَقَ، فَأَعْطِهِ إِيَّاهُ». قَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ: فَأَعْطَانِيهِ، فَبِعْتُ الدِّرْعَ فَابْتَعْتُ بِهِ مَخْرَفًا فِي بَنِي سَلِمَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ لَأَوَّلُ مَالٍ تَأَثَّلْتُ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ مَالِكٌ رضي الله عنه: الْمَخْرَفُ: النَّخْلُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from 'Amr b. Kathir b. Aflah, from Abu Muhammad, client of Abu Qatada, from Abu Qatada al-Ansari ﵁, who said:
entries.matn_en: We went out with the Messenger of God ﷺ in the year of Hunayn. When we met [the enemy], the Muslims had a rout. I saw a man of the polytheists who had overpowered a man of the Muslims. I circled around until I came to him from behind and struck him on the juncture of his neck and shoulder. He turned on me and gripped me in an embrace in which I felt the scent of death; then death overtook him and he let me go. I caught up with 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ and said to him: “What is the matter with the people?” He said: “God's command.” Then the people returned, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever has killed a slain man and has proof of it, his spoils are his.” I stood and said: “Who will testify for me?” Then I sat down. He said it a second time; I stood and said: “Who will testify for me?” and sat. He said it a third time, and I stood the third time. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “What is it with you, Abu Qatada?” I related the story to him. A man from the group said: “He has spoken truly, O Messenger of God, and the spoils of that slain man are with me; so satisfy him from them.” Abu Bakr said: “No, by God! He would not go to one of God's lions who fights on behalf of God and give you his spoils.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “He has spoken truly; give it to him.” Abu Qatada said: He gave it to me, and I sold the armor and bought with it a date orchard among Banu Salima; it was the first property I acquired in Islam. Malik ﵁ said: The mikhraf is a palm grove.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ يَطَئُونَ وَلَائِدَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَعْزِلُونَ، لَا تَأْتِيَنِي وَلِيدَةٌ يَعْتَرِفُ سَيِّدُهَا أَنْ قَدْ أَلَمَّ بِهَا إِلَّا أَلْحَقْتُ بِهِ وَلَدَهَا، فَاعْزِلُوا بَعْدُ أَوِ اتْرُكُوا» أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه فِي ⦗ص: 224⦘ إِرْسَالِ الْوَلَائِدِ يُطَأْنَ بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim b. 'Abd Allah, from his father, that 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ said:
entries.matn_en: “What is the matter with men who have intercourse with their slave girls and then practice withdrawal? No slave girl will come to me whose master admits that he has had relations with her without my attaching her child to him. So practice withdrawal after this, or refrain.” Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Safiyya bint Abi 'Ubayd, from 'Umar ﵁, concerning [p. 224] sending out slave girls to be had [by their masters], with a meaning similar to the report of Ibn Shihab from Salim.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ أَحْيَا أَرْضًا مَيْتَةً فَهِيَ لَهُ، وَلَيْسَ لِعِرْقِ ظَالِمٍ حَقٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Hisham, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever revives dead land, it is his; and a wrongdoer's root has no right.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ أَحْيَا أَرْضًا مَيْتَةً فَهِيَ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father, that 'Umar ﵁ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever revives dead land, it is his.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّافِعِيُّ، أَنَّ مَالِكًا، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا ضَرَرَ وَلَا ضِرَارَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Shafi'i informed us that Malik informed him, from 'Amr b. Yahya al-Mazini, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “There is to be no harm and no reciprocal harm.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدُكُمْ جَارَهُ أَنْ يَغْرِزَ خَشَبَةً فِي جِدَارِهِ» قَالَ: يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: مَا لِي أَرَاكُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ، وَاللَّهِ لَأَرْمِيَنَّ بِهَا بَيْنَ أَكْتَافِكُمْ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Let none of you prevent his neighbor from driving a beam into his wall.” He said: Abu Hurayra used to say: “Why do I see you turning away from it? By God, I will throw it between your shoulders.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الضَّحَّاكَ بْنَ خَلِيفَةَ، سَاقَ خَلِيجًا لَهُ مِنَ الْعُرَيْضِ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بِهِ فِي أَرْضٍ لِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ فَأَبَى مُحَمَّدٌ، فَكَلَّمَ فِيهِ الضَّحَّاكُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَدَعَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ مَسْلَمَةَ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُخَلِّيَ سَبِيلَهُ، فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ: لَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: " لِمَ تَمْنَعُ أَخَاكَ مَا يَنْفَعُهُ وَهُوَ لَكَ نَافِعٌ، تَشْرَبُ بِهِ أَوَّلًا وَآخِرًا وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ؟ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ: لَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: وَاللَّهِ لَيَمُرَّنَّ بِهِ وَلَوْ عَلَى بَطْنِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Amr b. Yahya al-Mazini, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: al-Dahhak b. Khalifa drew a canal of his from al-'Urayd and wanted to run it through land belonging to Muhammad b. Maslama, but Muhammad refused. Al-Dahhak spoke to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ about it, so he summoned Muhammad b. Maslama and ordered him to let it pass. Muhammad b. Maslama said: “No.” 'Umar said: “Why do you prevent your brother from something that benefits him and benefits you as well—you drink from it first and last, and it does not harm you?” Muhammad b. Maslama said: “No.” 'Umar ﵁ said: “By God, it will pass through, even if over your belly.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَاطِبٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَقِيقًا، لِحَاطِبٍ سَرَقُوا نَاقَةً لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ فَانْتَحَرُوهَا، فَرُفِعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَأَمَرَ كَثِيرَ بْنَ الصَّلْتِ أَنْ يَقْطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ عُمَرُ ⦗ص: 225⦘ : " إِنِّي أُرَاكَ تُجِيعُهُمْ، وَاللَّهِ لَأُغَرِّمَنَّكَ غُرْمًا يَشُقُّ عَلَيْكَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلْمُزَنِيِّ: كَمْ ثَمَنُ نَاقَتِكَ؟ قَالَ: أَرْبَعُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: أَعْطِهِ ثَمَانَ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from Yahya b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hatib, that
entries.matn_en: slaves of Hatib stole a she-camel belonging to a man of Muzayna and slaughtered her. The matter was brought to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁, who ordered Kathir b. al-Salt to cut off their hands. Then 'Umar said [p. 225]: “I see that you are starving them. By God, I will fine you a fine that is burdensome to you.” Then he said to the Muzani: “How much is your she-camel worth?” He said: “Four hundred dirhams.” 'Umar said: “Give him eight hundred dirhams.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُنَيْنَ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ، رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَنْبُوذًا فِي زَمَانِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَجَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ: " مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى أَخْذِ هَذِهِ النَّسَمَةِ؟ قَالَ: وَجَدْتُهَا ضَائِعَةً فَأَخَذْتُهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَرِيفُهُ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ صَالِحٌ، قَالَ: أَكَذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: «اذْهَبْ فَهُوَ حُرٌّ، وَلَكَ وَلَاؤُهُ، وَعَلَيْنَا نَفَقَتُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Sunayn Abu Jamila, a man of Banu Sulaym, that
entries.matn_en: he found an abandoned infant in the time of 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ and brought him to 'Umar b. al-Khattab. He said: “What moved you to take this soul?” He said: “I found it abandoned, so I took it.” His local headman said: “O Commander of the Faithful, he is a righteous man.” He said: “Is that so?” He said: “Yes.” 'Umar said: “Go; he is free, and his wala' is yours, and his maintenance is on us.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، جَاءَ بِغُلَامٍ لَهُ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ لَهُ: اقْطَعْ يَدَ هَذَا فَإِنَّهُ سَرَقَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: فَمَاذَا سَرَقَ؟ قَالَ: سَرَقَ مَرْآةً لِامْرَأَتِي ثَمَنُهَا سِتُّونَ دِرْهَمًا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «أَرْسِلْهُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَطْعٌ، خَادِمُكُمْ سَرَقَ مَتَاعَكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Sa'ib b. Yazid, that
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-Hadrami brought a boy of his to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ and said to him: “Cut off this one's hand, for he has stolen.” 'Umar ﵁ said to him: “What did he steal?” He said: “He stole a mirror belonging to my wife, worth sixty dirhams.” 'Umar ﵁ said: “Let him go; there is no amputation for him. Your servant stole your goods.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ، عَنْ أَسْلَمَ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَضَى فِي الضِّرْسِ بِجَمَلٍ، وَفِي التَّرْقُوَةِ بِجَمَلٍ، وَفِي الضِّلَعِ بِجَمَلٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Zayd b. Aslam, from Muslim b. Jundub, from Aslam, client of 'Umar b. al-Khattab, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ ruled a camel for a molar, a camel for the collarbone, and a camel for a rib.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتَ حَكِيمٍ، دَخَلَتْ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَتْ: إِنَّ «رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ اسْتَمْتَعَ بِامْرَأَةٍ مُوَلَّدَةٍ فَحَمَلَتْ مِنْهُ»، فَخَرَجَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه يَجُرُّ رِدَاءَهُ فَزِعًا فَقَالَ: «هَذِهِ الْمُتْعَةُ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ تَقَدَّمْتُ فِيهِ لَرَجَمْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa, that
entries.matn_en: Khawla bint Hakim came to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ and said: “Rabi'a b. Umayya contracted a temporary marriage (mut'a) with a muwallada woman and she became pregnant by him.” 'Umar ﵁ went out in alarm, dragging his cloak, and said: “This is mut'a; and had I advanced [a prohibition] on it, I would have stoned [him].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَصْدُرَنَّ ⦗ص: 226⦘ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْحَاجِّ حَتَّى يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ، فَإِنَّ آخِرَ النُّسُكِ الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ» قَالَ مَالِكٌ رضي الله عنه: " وَذَلِكَ فِيمَا نَرَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل: {ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ} [الْحَج: 33] فَمَحِلُّ الشَّعَائِرِ وَانْقِضَاؤُهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵁, that 'Umar said:
entries.matn_en: “Let none of the pilgrims depart [p. 226] until he has circumambulated the House, for the last of the rites is the circumambulation of the House.” Malik ﵁ said: “And that, as we see it, and God knows best, is because of the saying of God Almighty: {Then their place of sacrifice is at the Ancient House} [al-Hajj: 33]; so the place of the rites and their conclusion is at the Ancient House.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَضَى فِي الضَّبُعِ بِكَبْشٍ، وَفِي الْغَزَّالِ بِعَنْزٍ، وَفِي الْأَرْنَبِ بِعَنَاقٍ، وَفِي الْيَرْبُوعِ بِجَفْرَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us that Abu al-Zubayr narrated to him, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ ruled a ram for [killing] a hyena, a she-goat for a gazelle, a young goat ('anaq) for a hare, and a jafra [a young weaned goat] for a jerboa.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه بِالْعَرْجِ فِي يَوْمٍ صَائِفٍ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ وَقَدْ غَطَّى وَجْهَهُ بِقَطِيفَةِ أُرْجُوَانَ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِلَحْمِ صَيْدٍ فَقَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ: " كُلُوا، قَالُوا: أَلَا تَأْكُلُ أَنْتَ؟ قَالَ: إِنِّي لَسْتُ كَهَيْئَتِكُمْ، إِنَّمَا صِيدَ مِنْ أَجْلِي "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amir b. Rabi'a, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw 'Uthman b. 'Affan ﵁ at al-'Arj on a hot summer day while in ihram, with his face covered by a purple velvet cloak. Then game meat was brought to him and he said to his companions: “Eat.” They said: “Will you not eat?” He said: “I am not in your situation; it was hunted for my sake.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَغْوُ الْيَمِينِ قَوْلُ الْإِنْسَانِ: لَا وَاللَّهِ، وَبَلَى وَاللَّهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'A'isha ﵂, that she said:
entries.matn_en: “The idle oath is a person's saying: ‘No, by God’ and ‘Yes, by God.’”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الرِّجَالِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ عَمْرَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها دَبَّرَتْ جَارِيَةٌ لَهَا فَسَحَرَتْهَا فَاعْتَرَفَتْ بِالسِّحْرِ فَأَمَرَتْ بِهَا عَائِشَةُ رضي الله عنها أَنْ تُبَاعَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ مِمَّنْ يُسِيءُ مِلْكَتَهَا فَبِيعَتْ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Abu al-Rijal Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from his mother 'Amra, that
entries.matn_en: 'A'isha ﵂ had made a slave girl of hers a mudabbara [to be freed upon her death], and the girl bewitched her and confessed to the sorcery. 'A'isha ﵂ ordered that she be sold to Bedouins who would treat her badly as their property, and she was sold.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: وَرَجُلٌ، يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، سَلَفَ فِي سَبَائِكَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَبِيعَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْبِضَهَا، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: تِلْكَ الْوَرِقُ بِالْوَرِقِ، وَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَذَلِكَ فِيمَا نَرَى لِأَنَّهُ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبِيعَهَا مِنْ صَاحِبِهَا الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهَا مِنْهُ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثَّمَنِ الَّذِي ابْتَاعَهَا، وَلَوْ بَاعَهَا الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهَا مِنْهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِبَيْعِهِ بَأْسٌ
entries.matn_en: Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from al-Qasim: I heard 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas being asked by a man about someone who had made an advance purchase (salaf) of silver ingots and wanted to sell them before taking possession. Ibn 'Abbas said: “That is silver for silver,” and disliked it. Malik said: And that, as we see it, is because he wanted to sell them to the person he bought them from for more than the price he had paid; had he sold them to someone other than the one from whom he bought them, there would be no harm in his sale.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَمَّا الَّذِي نَهَى عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَهُوَ الطَّعَامُ أَنْ يُبَاعَ حَتَّى يُقْبَضَ. قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِرَأْيِهِ، وَلَا أَحْسِبُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Tawus, from Ibn 'Abbas ﵄, who said:
entries.matn_en: “What the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade is food being sold until it is taken possession of.” Ibn 'Abbas said, by his own opinion: “And I think everything is like it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ صُعَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه صَلَّى بِهِمْ بِالْجَابِيَةِ فَقَرَأَ بِسُورَةِ الْحَجِّ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا سَجْدَتَيْنِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Ibrahim informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abd Allah b. Tha'laba b. Su'ayr, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ led them in prayer at al-Jabiya and recited Surat al-Hajj and made two prostrations in it.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَجَدَ فِي سُورَةِ الْحَجِّ سَجْدَتَيْنِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he made two prostrations in Surat al-Hajj.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا رَعَفَ انْصَرَفَ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ وَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: when he had a nosebleed he would leave, perform ablution, then return without speaking.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ أَصَابَهُ رُعَافٌ، أَوْ مَنْ وَجَدَ رُعَافًا، أَوْ مَذْيًا أَوْ قَيْئًا انْصَرَفَ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَبَنَى»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Majid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he used to say: “Whoever is afflicted with a nosebleed, or finds [himself with] a nosebleed, prostatic discharge, or vomiting, should leave, perform ablution, then return and build upon [his prayer].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ تَيَمَّمَ بِمَرْبَدِ النَّعَمِ وَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ فَلَمْ يُعِدِ الصَّلَاةَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn 'Ajlan, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he performed tayammum at Mirbad al-Na'am and prayed 'Asr, then entered Medina while the sun was still high and did not repeat the prayer.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما بِمَكَّةَ وَالسَّمَاءُ مُتَغَيِّمَةٌ فَخَشِيَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتَرَ بِوَاحِدَةٍ، ثُمَّ تَكَشَّفَ الْغَيْمُ فَرَأَى عَلَيْهِ لَيْلًا فَشَفَعَ بِوَاحِدَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: I was with Ibn 'Umar ﵄ in Mecca while the sky was overcast, and Ibn 'Umar feared the dawn, so he prayed witr with one rak'a. Then the clouds cleared and he saw that night remained, so he made [the prayer] even by adding one.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُصَلِّي وَرَاءَ الْإِمَامِ بِمِنًى أَرْبَعًا، فَإِذَا صَلَّى لِنَفْسِهِ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he would pray four [rak'as] behind the imam at Mina, and when he prayed for himself he prayed two.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُصَلِّي مَعَ ⦗ص: 228⦘ الْفَرِيضَةِ فِي السَّفَرِ شَيْئًا قَبْلَهَا وَلَا بَعْدَهَا إِلَّا مِنْ جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ
entries.isnad_en: And with this chain, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he did not pray anything with [p. 228] the obligatory prayer when traveling, neither before it nor after it, except in the middle of the night.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ لَا يَقْنُتُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
entries.isnad_en: And with this chain, that
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar did not recite qunut in any of the prayers.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُصَلِّي يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ قَبْلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَلَا بَعْدَهَا
entries.isnad_en: And with this chain, that
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar did not pray on the day of al-Fitr, neither before the ['id] prayer nor after it.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي صَلَاةِ الْخَوْفِ بِشَيْءٍ خَالَفْتُمُوهُ فِيهِ وَمَالِكٌ رحمه الله يَقُولُ: لَا أَذْكُرُهُ إِلَّا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ يَرْوِيهِ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَا يَشُكُّ فِيهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: regarding the fear prayer, [a report] on a matter in which you [Malikis] contradicted it; and Malik ﵀ says: “I mention it only from the Messenger of God ﷺ.” And Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrates it from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, without any doubt about it.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما كَانَ يَنَامُ وَهُوَ قَاعِدٌ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي وَلَا يَتَوَضَّأُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', that
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar ﵄ would sleep while sitting, then pray without performing ablution.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ نَامَ مُضْطَجِعًا وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْوُضُوءُ، وَمَنْ نَامَ جَالِسًا فَلَا وُضُوءَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: The trustworthy one informed us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever sleeps lying down must perform ablution, and whoever sleeps sitting need not perform ablution.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَالَ فِي السُّوقِ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَدُعِيَ لِجَنَازَةٍ فَمَسَحَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he urinated in the marketplace, then performed ablution—washing his face and hands and wiping his head—then entered the mosque, and when he was called to a funeral he wiped over his leather socks and prayed.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْإِقَامَةَ، وَهُوَ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَأَسْرَعَ الْمَشْيَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ
entries.matn_en: And with this chain, from Ibn 'Umar, that he heard the iqama while at al-Baqi' and hurried his walk to the mosque.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ إِذَا ابْتَدَأَ الصَّلَاةَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ رَفَعَهُمَا كَذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: And with this chain, that
entries.matn_en: when Ibn 'Umar began the prayer he raised his hands level with his shoulders, and when he rose from bowing he raised them likewise.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا سَجَدَ وَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى الَّذِي يَضَعُ عَلَيْهِ وَجْهَهُ. قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ فِي يَوْمٍ شَدِيدِ الْبَرْدِ يُخْرِجُ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ تَحْتِ بُرْنُسٍ لَهُ
entries.isnad_en: And with this chain, from Ibn 'Umar, that when he prostrated he placed his palms on what he placed his face on. He said:
entries.matn_en: “I saw him on a very cold day take his hands out from under his hooded cloak.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أُمِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعٍ، فَذَكَرَ مِنْهَا كَفَّيْهِ وَرُكْبَتَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ was commanded to prostrate on seven [limbs],” and he mentioned among them his palms and his knees.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَامِلِ، إِذَا خَافَتْ عَلَى ⦗ص: 229⦘ وَلَدِهَا، قَالَ: تُفْطِرُ وَتُطْعِمُ مَكَانَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِينًا مَدًّا مِنْ حِنْطَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', that
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar was asked about a pregnant woman who fears for [p. 229] her child. He said: “She breaks her fast and feeds, in place of each day, one poor person a mudd of wheat.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ لُبْسَ الْمِنْطَقَةِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ
entries.isnad_en: And with this chain, that
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar disliked a person in ihram wearing a belt.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: {مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ} بَعِيرٌ أَوْ بَقَرَةٌ
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he used to say: {whatever is feasible of sacrificial animals} [means] a camel or a cow.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ إِذَا حَلَقَ فِي حَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةْ أَخَذَ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ وَشَارِبِهِ
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: that when he shaved in hajj or 'umra, he would [also] trim from his beard and his moustache.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ وَهُمَا غَادِيَانِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ: كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: كَانَ يُهِلُّ الْمُهِلُّ مِنَّا فَلَا يُنْكِرُ عَلَيْهِ، وَيُكَبِّرُ الْمُكَبِّرُ مِنَّا فَلَا يُنْكِرُ عَلَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Muhammad b. Abi Bakr al-Thaqafi, that
entries.matn_en: he asked Anas b. Malik while they were both going in the morning from Mina to 'Arafa: “How did you do on this day with the Messenger of God ﷺ?” He said: “One who recited the talbiya among us would recite it and was not objected to, and one who recited the takbir would recite it and was not objected to.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَغْدُو مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ إِذَا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he would go in the morning from Mina to 'Arafa when the sun had risen.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ حَجَّ فِي الْفِتْنَةِ فَأَهَلَّ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ فَقَالَ: «مَا أَمْرُهُمَا إِلَّا وَاحِدٌ، أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ الْحَجَّ مَعَ الْعُمْرَةِ»
entries.matn_en: And with it, that Ibn 'Umar performed hajj during the civil strife (fitna), entered ihram, then reflected and said: “The two are but one matter. I call you to witness that I have made hajj obligatory for myself together with 'umra.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا مَلَّكَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَالْقَضَاءُ مَا قَضَتْ إِلَّا أَنْ يُنَاكِرُهَا الرَّجُلُ فَيَقُولُ: لَمْ أُرِدْ إِلَّا تَطْلِيقَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَيَحْلِفُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَيَكُونُ أَمْلَكَ بِهَا مَا كَانَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: And with it, that Ibn 'Umar used to say:
entries.matn_en: “When a man gives his wife authority [over her divorce] (tamlik), the decision is what she decides, unless the man disputes it, saying: ‘I intended only one divorce,’ and swears an oath to that effect; then he is more entitled to her for as long as she is in her waiting period.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ، كَانَ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ فَأَتَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ وَعَيْنَاهُ تَدْمَعَانِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ: مَا شَأْنُكَ؟ قَالَ: مَلَّكْتُ امْرَأَتِي أَمْرَهَا فَفَارَقَتْنِي، فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدٌ: مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ: الْقَدَرُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدٌ: «ارْتَجِعْهَا إِنْ شِئْتَ؛ فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ وَاحِدَةٌ، وَأَنْتَ أَمْلَكُ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Sa'id ibn Sulayman b. Zayd b. Thabit, from Kharija b. Zayd, who informed him that
entries.matn_en: he was sitting with Zayd b. Thabit when Muhammad b. Abi 'Atiq came to him with tears in his eyes. Zayd b. Thabit said to him: “What is the matter with you?” He said: “I gave my wife authority over her affair and she separated from me.” Zayd said to him: “What led you to that?” He said: “Destiny.” Zayd said to him: “Take her back if you wish, for it is only one [divorce], and you are more entitled to her.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «لِكُلِّ مُطْلَقَةٍ مُتْعَةٌ إِلَّا الَّتِي تُطَلَّقُ وَقَدْ فُرِضَ لَهَا الصَّدَاقُ فَلَمْ تُمَسَّ، فَحَسْبُهَا مَا فُرِضَ لَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he used to say: “Every divorced woman has a compensatory gift (mut'a), except one who is divorced after a dowry was fixed for her and she was not touched; what was fixed for her suffices her.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «فِي الْخَلِيَّةِ وَالْبَرِيَّةِ ثَلَاثًا ثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar, that he said regarding [the expressions] al-khaliyya and al-bariyya:
entries.matn_en: “Three, three [divorces].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ اشْتَرَى رَاحِلَةً بِأَرْبَعَةِ أَبْعِرَةٍ مَضْمُونَةٍ عَلَيْهِ بِالرَّبَذَةِ
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he bought a riding camel for four camels guaranteed [for delivery] at al-Rabadha.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجْتُ مَعَ جَدَّةٍ لِي عَلَيْهَا مَشْيٌ إِلَى بَيْتِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتْ بِبَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ عَجَزَتْ، فَسَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ: «مُرْهَا فَلْتَرْكَبْ ثُمَّ لِتَمْشِ مِنْ حَيْثُ عَجَزَتْ» قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَعَلَيْهَا هَدْيٌ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Urwa b. Udhayna, who said:
entries.matn_en: I set out with a grandmother of mine who had vowed to walk to the House of God, and when she was partway along the road she became unable [to continue]. I asked 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, and 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said: “Tell her to ride, then walk from the point where she became unable.” Malik said: And she owes a sacrificial animal.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَوَكَّدَهَا فَعَلَيْهِ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever swears an oath and emphasizes it, he must free a slave.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَبْعَثُ بِزَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ إِلَى الَّذِي تُجْمَعُ عِنْدَهُ قَبْلَ الْفِطْرِ بِيَوْمَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he used to send the zakat al-fitr to the person with whom it was collected, two or three days before al-Fitr.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدًا، لَهُ سَرَقَ وَهُوَ آبِقٌ فَأَبَى سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْعَاصِ يَقْطَعُهُ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَقُطِعَتْ يَدَهُ
entries.isnad_en: And with it, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: a slave of his stole while a runaway, and Sa'id ibn al-'As refused to cut his hand, so Ibn 'Umar ordered it and his hand was cut off.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَمْعَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أُمَّهُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَرْضَعَتْهَا أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ امْرَأَةُ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ، فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ: فَكَانَ الزُّبَيْرُ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيَّ وَأَنَا أَمْتَشِطُ، فَيَأْخُذُ بِقَرْنٍ مِنْ قُرُونِ رَأْسِي فَيَقُولُ: أَقْبِلِي عَلَيَّ فَحَدِّثِينِي، أُرَاهُ أَنَّهُ أَبِي، وَمَا وَلَدَ فَهُمْ إِخْوَتِي، ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ قَبْلَ الْحَرَّةِ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَّ فَخَطَبَ إِلَيَّ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ ابْنَتِي عَلَى حَمْزَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَكَانَ حَمْزَةُ لِلْكَلْبِيَّةِ، فَقُلْتُ لِرَسُولِهِ: وَهَلْ تَحِلُّ لَهُ؟ إِنَّمَا هِيَ ابْنَةُ أُخْتِهِ ⦗ص: 231⦘ ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: إِنَّمَا أَرَدْتِ بِهَذَا الْمَنْعَ لِمَا قِبَلَكِ لَيْسَ لَكِ بِأَخٍ، أَنَا وَمَا وَلَدَتْ أَسْمَاءُ فَهُمْ إِخْوَتُكِ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ وَلَدِ الزُّبَيْرِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَسْمَاءَ فَلَيْسُوا لَكِ بِإِخْوَةٍ، فَأَرْسِلِي فَاسْأَلِي عَنْ هَذَا، فَأَرْسَلْتُ فَسَأَلْتُ، وَأَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَوَافِرُونَ وَأُمَّهَاتُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَقَالُوا لَهَا: «إِنَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الرَّجُلِ لَا تُحَرِّمُ شَيْئًا»، فَأَنْكَحْتُهَا إِيَّاهُ، فَلَمْ تَزَلْ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى هَلَكَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Amr, from Abu 'Ubayda b. 'Abd Allah b. Zam'a, that
entries.matn_en: his mother Zaynab bint Abi Salama was nursed by Asma' bint Abi Bakr, wife of al-Zubayr b. al-'Awwam. Zaynab bint Abi Salama said: “Al-Zubayr used to enter upon me while I was combing my hair; he would take hold of a lock of my hair and say: ‘Turn to me and talk to me,’ regarding himself as my father, and his children as my brothers. Then, before [the battle of] al-Harra, 'Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr sent to me and asked for my daughter Umm Kulthum in marriage for Hamza b. al-Zubayr—Hamza being the son of the Kalbi woman. I said to his messenger: ‘Is she lawful for him? She is the daughter of his [foster-]sister.’ [p. 231] 'Abd Allah sent back to me: ‘You only want to prevent this because of what you have in mind; he is no brother to you. I and whatever Asma' bore are your brothers, and whatever of al-Zubayr's children were not from Asma' are not brothers to you. Send and ask about this.’ So I sent and asked, while the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ and the Mothers of the Believers were present in numbers, and they said to her: ‘Fosterage through the man does not make anything unlawful.’ So I gave her in marriage to him, and she remained with him until he died.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «جَاءَ عَمِّي أَفْلَحُ، وَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ» قَالَ الرَّبِيعُ: زَعَمَ الشَّافِعِيُّ مَا أَحَدٌ أَشَدَّ خِلَافًا لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ مَالِكٍ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha ﵂, who said:
entries.matn_en: “My [foster-]uncle Aflah came,” and he mentioned the hadith. Al-Rabi' said: Al-Shafi'i claimed that no one is more at odds with the people of Medina than Malik.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَعَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، وَعَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ، مِنْ قِبَلِ الرِّجَالِ لَا تُحَرِّمُ شَيْئًا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Amr b. 'Alqama, from Yazid b. 'Abd Allah b. Qusayt, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab and Abu Salama, and from Sulayman b. Yasar, and from 'Ata' b. Yasar, that
entries.matn_en: fosterage through the men [i.e., the husband's side] does not make anything unlawful.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، خَطَبَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم امْرَأَةً قَائِمَةً، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي صَدَاقِهَا فَقَالَ: «الْتَمِسْ وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Abu Hazim b. Dinar, that he heard Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi [say] that
entries.matn_en: a man proposed to the Prophet ﷺ regarding a woman who was standing [there], and the Prophet ﷺ spoke to him about her dowry. He said: “Look [for something], even an iron ring.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ،
entries.matn_ar: إِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، وَعُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنهما قَضَيَا فِي الْمُلْطَاةِ بِنِصْفِ دِيَةِ الْمُوضِحَةِ أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، وَعُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنهما مِثْلَهُ أَوْ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ ⦗ص: 232⦘ . قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ ابْنَ نَافِعٍ يَذْكُرُ عَنْ مَالِكٍ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ. قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: وَقَرَأْنَا عَلَى مَالِكٍ أَنَّا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْأَئِمَّةِ فِي الْقَدِيمِ وَلَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَضَى فِيمَا دُونَ الْمُوضِحَةِ بِشَيْءٍ
entries.isnad_en: The trustworthy one informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Harith—if I
entries.matn_en: did not hear it from 'Abd Allah himself—from Malik b. Anas, from Yazid b. Qusayt, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that 'Umar and 'Uthman ﵄ ruled, in the case of the multah [a wound reaching the thin membrane over the skull bone], half the blood-money of a mudiha [a wound exposing the bone]. Muslim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from al-Thawri, from Malik, from Yazid b. 'Abd Allah b. Qusayt, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from 'Umar and 'Uthman ﵄, the same or with a similar meaning. [p. 232] Al-Shafi'i said: And someone who heard Ibn Nafi' informed me that he mentioned from Malik, with this chain, the same. Al-Shafi'i said: And we read to Malik [the statement] that we know of no one among the leaders, in earlier or later times, who ruled anything for wounds less than a mudiha.

sections.title_en: From al-Risāla, excluding repeated material
sections.title_ar: وَمِنْ كِتَابِ الرِّسَالَةِ إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مُعَادًا

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ} [الشَّرْح: 4]: لَا أُذْكَرُ إِلَّا ذُكِرْتَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying
entries.matn_en: {And We raised high for you your mention} [al-Sharh: 4]: “I am not mentioned except that you are mentioned: ‘I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God.’”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ، سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: بَايَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى النُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa: I heard Jarir b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: I pledged allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ to give sincere counsel to every Muslim.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ رضي الله عنه قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ، الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ، الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ، لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِنَبِيِّهِ وَلِأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from 'Ata' b. Yazid al-Laythi, from Tamim al-Dari ﵁, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Religion is sincere counsel; religion is sincere counsel; religion is sincere counsel—for God, for His Book, for His Prophet, and for the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، مَوْلَى الْمُطَّلِبِ، عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ حَنْطَبٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا تَرَكْتُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ إِلَّا وَقَدْ أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ، وَلَا تَرَكْتُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِلَّا وَقَدْ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ، وَإِنَّ الرُّوحَ الْأَمِينَ قَدْ نَفَثَ فِي رُوعِي أَنَّهُ لَنْ تَمُوتَ نَفْسٌ حَتَّى تَسْتَوْفِيَ رِزْقَهَا، فَأَجْمِلُوا فِي الطَّلَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from 'Amr b. Abi 'Amr, client of al-Muttalib, from al-Muttalib b. Hantab, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “I have left nothing of what God has commanded you except that I have commanded you to it, and I have left nothing of what He has forbidden you except that I have forbidden you from it. The Trustworthy Spirit has breathed into my heart that no soul will die until it has fully received its provision; so be moderate in seeking [it].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ ⦗ص: 234⦘ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا أُلْفِيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى أَرِيكَتِهِ يَأْتِيهِ الْأَمْرُ مِنْ أَمْرِي مِمَّا أَمَرْتُ بِهِ أَوْ نَهَيْتُ عَنْهُ فَيَقُولُ: لَا أَدْرِي، مَا وَجَدْنَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ اتَّبَعْنَاهُ " قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُرْسَلًا قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رضي الله عنه: الْأَرِيكَةُ: السَّرِيرُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Salim Abu al-Nadr, client of 'Umar b. 'Ubayd Allah, who heard 'Ubayd [p. 234] Allah b. Abi Rafi' narrating from his father, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Let me not find any one of you reclining on his couch, when a matter of mine comes to him—something I commanded or forbade—and he says: ‘I do not know; what we find in the Book of God we follow.’” Sufyan said: Muhammad b. al-Munkadir also narrated it to me from the Prophet ﷺ as a mursal report. Al-Shafi'i ﵁ said: The arika is the couch.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي سُهَيْلِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ طَلْحَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ مِنْ أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ ثَائِرُ الرَّأْسِ يُسْمَعُ دَوِيُّ صَوْتِهِ وَلَا يُفْقَهُ مَا يَقُولُ حَتَّى دَنَا، فَإِذَا هُوَ يَسْأَلُ عَنِ الْإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ». قَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيَّ غَيْرَهَا؟ قَالَ: «لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَطَوَّعَ». وَذَكَرَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صِيَامَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ، فَقَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيَّ غَيْرُهُ؟ قَالَ: «لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَطَوَّعَ». فَأَدْبَرَ الرَّجُلُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: وَاللَّهِ لَا أَزِيدُ عَلَى هَذَا وَلَا أَنْقُصُ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَفْلَحَ إِنْ صَدَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from his uncle Abu Suhayl b. Malik, from his father, that he heard Talha b. 'Ubayd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: A Bedouin from the people of Najd came, with disheveled hair; the rumble of his voice was heard but what he said could not be understood until he came near, and it turned out he was asking about Islam. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Five prayers in the day and night.” He said: “Is there anything else upon me?” He said: “No, unless you volunteer.” The Messenger of God ﷺ then mentioned to him the fast of the month of Ramadan. He said: “Is there anything else upon me?” He said: “No, unless you volunteer.” The man turned away saying: “By God, I will not add to this nor subtract from it.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “He will have succeeded, if he is truthful.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها وَذَكَرَتْ إِحْرَامَهَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا حَاضَتْ فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَقْضِيَ مَا يَقْضِي الْحَاجُّ غَيْرَ أَنْ لَا تَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَلَا تُصَلِّيَ حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim, from his father, from 'A'isha ﵂, who mentioned her entering ihram with the Prophet ﷺ, that
entries.matn_en: she began to menstruate, so he commanded her to perform what a pilgrim performs, except that she not circumambulate the House nor pray until she was pure.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَيْنَمَا النَّاسُ بِقُبَاءٍ فِي صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ آتٍ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلَةَ قُرْآنٌ، وَقَدْ أُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا، وَكَانَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَاسْتَدَارُوا إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “While the people were at Quba' in the dawn prayer, someone came to them and said: ‘Qur'an was revealed to the Prophet ﷺ tonight, and he has been commanded to face the Ka'ba, so face it.’ Their faces were toward Syria, so they turned around toward the Ka'ba.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا نَحْوَ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ، ثُمَّ حُوِّلَتِ الْقِبْلَةُ قَبْلَ بَدْرٍ بِشَهْرَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that
entries.matn_en: he used to say: “The Messenger of God ﷺ prayed sixteen months toward Bayt al-Maqdis, then the qibla was changed two months before Badr.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ⦗ص: 235⦘ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا وَصِيَّةَ لِوَارِثٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Mujahid, that the Messenger of God ﷺ [p. 235] said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no bequest for an heir.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةَ رِفَاعَةَ جَاءَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ: إِنَّ رِفَاعَةَ طَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلَاقِي، وَإِنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ تَزَوَّجَنِي، وَإِنَّمَا مَعَهُ مِثْلُ هُدْبَةِ الثَّوْبِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَتُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ؟ لَا، حَتَّى تَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ وَيَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr, from 'A'isha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, that
entries.matn_en: the wife of Rifa'a came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “Rifa'a divorced me, finalizing my divorce, and 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Zubayr married me, but all he has is like the fringe of a garment.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Do you wish to return to Rifa'a? No, not until you have tasted his sweetness and he has tasted your sweetness.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ، وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ali b. Husayn, from 'Amr b. 'Uthman, from Usama b. Zayd, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “A Muslim does not inherit from an unbeliever, nor an unbeliever from a Muslim.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ بَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ فَمَالُهُ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever sells a slave who has property, his property belongs to the seller, unless the buyer stipulates [otherwise].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سُرَاقَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ بَنِي أَنْمَارٍ كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ مُتَوَجِّهَةً قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ، لَا أَدْرِي أَسَمَّى بَنِي أَنْمَارٍ أَوْ قَالَ: صَلَّى فِي سَفَرٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from 'Uthman b. 'Abd Allah b. Suraqa, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ, in the campaign against Banu Anmar, used to pray on his mount while it faced east. Muslim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, from the Prophet ﷺ, with a similar meaning; I do not know whether he named Banu Anmar or said: “He prayed on a journey.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أُرَاهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرَ صَلَاةَ الْخَوْفِ فَقَالَ: «إِنْ كَانَ خَوْفًا أَشَدَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ صَلُّوا رِجَالًا وَرُكْبَانًا مُسْتَقْبِلِي الْقِبْلَةِ وَغَيْرَ مُسْتَقْبِلِيهَا» ⦗ص: 236⦘ أَخْبَرَنَا رَجُلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ، وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ أَنَّهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَأَنَّهُ مَرْفُوعٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar—I think from the Prophet ﷺ—who
entries.matn_en: mentioned the fear prayer and said: “If the fear is more intense than that, they pray on foot or mounted, facing the qibla or not facing it.” [p. 236] A man informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, with a similar meaning, and he had no doubt that it was from his father and that it is attributed directly to the Prophet ﷺ.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id and Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “And on buried treasure (rikaz) a fifth.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Idris al-Khawlani, from Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ forbade eating every predatory animal with a fang.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَكْلُ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ حَرَامٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Isma'il b. Abi Hakim, from 'Abida b. Sufyan al-Hadrami, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Eating every predatory animal with a fang is forbidden.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَزْهَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: شَهِدْتُ الْعِيدَ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: لَا يَأْكُلَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ لَحْمِ نُسُكِهِ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu 'Ubayd, client of Ibn Azhar, who said:
entries.matn_en: I attended the 'Id with 'Ali b. Abi Talib ﵁ and heard him say: “Let none of you eat from the meat of his sacrifice after three [days].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يَأْكُلَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نُسُكِهِ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ»
entries.isnad_en: The trustworthy one informed us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu 'Ubayd, from 'Ali ﵁, that he said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Let none of you eat from his sacrifice after three [days].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّا لَنَذْبَحُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ضَحَايَانَا، ثُمَّ نَتَزَوَّدُ بَقِيَّتَهَا إِلَى الْبَصْرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed me, from Ibrahim b. Maysara, who said: I heard Anas b. Malik say:
entries.matn_en: “We would slaughter of our sacrificial animals what God willed, then take the remainder as provisions to Basra.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَعَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُمَا أَخْبَرَاهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ اخْتَصَمَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ وَهُوَ أَفْقَهُهُمَا: أَجَلْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَاقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَائْذَنْ لِي فِي أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ، قَالَ: «تَكَلَّمْ». قَالَ: إِنَّ ⦗ص: 237⦘ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا عَلَى هَذَا فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ، فَأُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّ عَلَى ابْنِيَ الرَّجْمَ، فَافْتَدَيْتُ مِنْهُ بِمِائَةِ شَاةٍ وَبِجَارِيَةٍ لِي، ثُمَّ إِنِّي سَأَلْتُ أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ فَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّ عَلَى ابْنِي جَلْدَ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبَ عَامٍ، وَإِنَّمَا الرَّجْمُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، أَمَّا غَنَمُكَ وَجَارِيَتُكَ فَرَدٌّ إِلَيْكَ» وَجَلَدَ ابْنَهُ مِائَةً وَغَرَّبَهُ عَامًا، وَأَمَرَ أُنَيْسًا الْأَسْلَمِيَّ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ امْرَأَةَ الْآخَرِ فَإِنِ اعْتَرَفَتْ فَارْجُمْهَا، فَاعْتَرَفَتْ فَرَجَمَهَا
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba, from Abu Hurayra and from Zayd b. Khalid al-Juhani, who both informed him that
entries.matn_en: two men brought a dispute to the Messenger of God ﷺ. One of them said: “O Messenger of God, judge between us by the Book of God.” The other—who was the more knowledgeable of the two—said: “Yes, O Messenger of God, judge between us by the Book of God, and permit me to speak.” He said: “Speak.” He said: “My [p. 237] son was a hired laborer for this man and committed adultery with his wife. I was told that my son is liable to stoning, so I ransomed him with a hundred sheep and a slave girl of mine. Then I asked the people of knowledge, and they informed me that my son is liable to a hundred lashes and a year's banishment, and that stoning applies only to his wife.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “By Him in whose hand is my soul, I will judge between you by the Book of God. As for your sheep and your slave girl, they are returned to you.” He flogged his son a hundred lashes and banished him for a year, and commanded Unays al-Aslami to go to the other man's wife and, if she confessed, to stone her. She confessed and he stoned her.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَمَ يَهُودِيَّيْنِ زَنَيَا
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ stoned two Jews who had committed adultery.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ،
entries.matn_ar: عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ التَّشَهُّدَ يَقُولُ: " قُولُوا: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، الزَّاكِيَاتُ لِلَّهِ، الطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ لِلَّهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ "
entries.matn_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd al-Qari, that he heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab on the pulpit teaching the people the tashahhud, saying: “Say: Greetings are for God; the pure [deeds] are for God; the good [words] and the prayers are for God. Peace be upon you, O Prophet; peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of God. I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ،
entries.matn_ar: يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا أَقْرَأُهَا، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْرَأَنِيهَا، فَكِدْتُ أَنْ أَعْجَلَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَمْهَلْتُهُ حَتَّى انْصَرَفَ، ثُمَّ لَبَّبْتُهُ بِرِدَائِهِ فَجِئْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا أَقْرَأْتَنِيهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اقْرَأْ». فَقَرَأَ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ». ثُمَّ قَالَ لِيَ: «اقْرَأْ». فَقَرَأْتُ فَقَالَ: «هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ، إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ، فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ»
entries.matn_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd al-Qari, who said: I heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ say: I heard Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam reciting Surat al-Furqan differently from how I recite it, and the Prophet ﷺ had taught it to me. I almost rushed upon him, but I gave him time until he finished; then I seized him by his cloak and brought him to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of God, I heard this man reciting Surat al-Furqan differently from how you taught it to me.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “Recite.” He recited the recitation I had heard him recite, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Thus it was revealed.” Then he said to me: “Recite.” I recited, and he said: “Thus it was revealed. This Qur'an was revealed in seven modes (ahruf), so recite what is easy of it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
