entries.matn_ar: «الدِّينَارُ بِالدِّينَارِ، وَالدِّرْهَمُ بِالدِّرْهَمِ لَا فَضْلَ بَيْنَهُمَا، هَذَا عَهْدُ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْنَا، وَعَهْدُنَا إِلَيْكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Humayd b. Qays, from Mujahid, from Ibn 'Umar, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “A dinar for a dinar and a dirham for a dirham, with no surplus between them; this is the covenant of our Prophet ﷺ with us, and our covenant with you.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الصَّعْبُ بْنُ جَثَّامَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسْأَلُ عَنْ أَهْلِ الدَّارِ، مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يُبَيَّتُونَ فَيُصَابُ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ وَذَرَارِيِّهِمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هُمْ مِنْهُمْ» وَزَادَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ: «هُمْ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba, from Ibn 'Abbas: al-Sa'b b. Jaththama informed me
entries.matn_en: that he heard the Prophet ﷺ being asked about the people of a household of polytheists who are attacked at night, and some of their women and children are hit. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “They are from them.” And 'Amr b. Dinar added from al-Zuhri: “They are from their fathers.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا بَعَثَ إِلَى ابْنِ أَبِي الْحُقَيْقِ نَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from the son of Ka'b b. Malik, from his uncle ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: when the Prophet ﷺ sent [a party] against Ibn Abi al-Huqayq, he forbade the killing of women and children.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَخْطُبُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: أَيَّةُ سَاعَةٍ هَذِهِ؟ فَقَالَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، انْقَلَبْتُ مِنَ السُّوقِ فَسَمِعْتُ النِّدَاءَ فَمَا زِدْتُ عَلَى أَنْ تَوَضَّأْتُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: وَالْوُضُوءُ أَيْضًا، وَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْغُسْلِ أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، مِثْلَ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ، وَسَمَّى الدَّاخِلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ بِغَيْرِ غُسْلٍ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ entered the mosque on Friday while 'Umar b. al-Khattab was delivering the sermon. 'Umar said: “What time is this?” He said: “O Commander of the Faithful, I returned from the market, heard the call, and did nothing more than perform ablution.” 'Umar said: “Ablution too?! And you know that the Messenger of God ﷺ used to command the full bath.” The trustworthy one informed us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father, with a meaning like the report of Malik, and he named the one who entered on Friday without a full bath as 'Uthman b. 'Affan ﵁.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رَأَيْتُ أَنَا وَعَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، ابْنَ عُمَرَ، طَافَ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ وَصَلَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “'Ata' b. Abi Rabah and I saw Ibn 'Umar circumambulate after the dawn prayer and pray before the sun rose.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ الْقَدَّاحُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أَلَمْ أُنَبَّأْ، أَوْ: أَلَمْ يَبْلُغْنِي، أَوْ كَمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، أَنَّكَ تَبِيعُ الطَّعَامَ؟ " قَالَ حَكِيمٌ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا تَبِيعَنَّ طَعَامًا حَتَّى تَشْتَرِيَهُ وَتَسْتَوْفِيَهُ» أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِصْمَةَ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Salim al-Qaddah informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah, from Safwan b. Mawhab, who informed him from 'Abd Allah b. Muhammad b. Sayfi, from Hakim b. Hizam ﵁, that he said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said to me: “Have I not been informed—or: has it not reached me, or as God willed it—that you sell food?” Hakim said: “Yes, O Messenger of God.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Do not sell food until you have bought it and taken full possession of it.” Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj: 'Ata' informed me of that also, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Isma, from Hakim b. Hizam, that he heard it from him, from the Prophet ﷺ.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ بْنِ بُخْتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ النَّصْرِيِّ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الْأَسْقَعِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ أَفْرَى الْفِرَى مَنْ قَوَّلَنِي مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ، وَمَنْ أَرَى عَيْنَيْهِ فِي الْمَنَامِ مَا لَمْ تَرَيَا، وَمَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Darawardi informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan, from 'Abd al-Wahhab b. Bukht, from 'Abd al-Wahid al-Nasri, from Wathila b. al-Asqa', from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Among the gravest of falsehoods is one who puts words in my mouth that I did not say; one who makes his eyes see in a dream what they did not see; and one who claims a father other than his own.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ قَالَ عَلَيَّ مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Amr, from Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever says about me what I did not say, let him take his seat in the Fire.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ الَّذِيَ يَكْذِبُ عَلَيَّ يُبْنَى لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Sulaym informed us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Abu Bakr, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever lies about me, a house will be built for him in the Fire.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ التِّنِّيسِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُسَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي قَتَادَةَ: مَا لَكَ لَا تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا يُحَدِّثُ عَنْهُ النَّاسُ؟ قَالَتْ: فَقَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ فَلْيَلْتَمِسْ لِجَنْبِهِ مَضْجَعًا مِنَ النَّارِ». فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ وَيَمْسَحُ الْأَرْضَ بِيَدِهِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Amr b. Abi Salama al-Tinnisi informed us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad, from Usayd b. Abi Usayd, from his mother, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Abu Qatada: “Why do you not narrate from the Messenger of God ﷺ as people narrate from him?” She said: Abu Qatada said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “Whoever lies about me, let him seek a resting place for his side in the Fire.” The Messenger of God ﷺ kept saying that while wiping the ground with his hand.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «حَدِّثُوا عَنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَا حَرَجَ، وَحَدِّثُوا عَنِّي وَلَا تَكْذِبُوا عَلَيَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Muhammad b. 'Amr, from Abu Salama, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Narrate from the Children of Israel, there is no harm; and narrate from me, but do not lie about me.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " نَضَّرَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا سَمِعَ مَقَالَتِي فَحَفِظَهَا وَوَعَاهَا وَأَدَّاهَا، فَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ غَيْرِ فَقِيهٍ، وَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَهُ مِنْهُ، ثَلَاثٌ لَا يُغِلُّ عَلَيْهِنَّ قَلْبُ مُسْلِمٍ: إِخْلَاصُ الْعَمَلِ لِلَّهِ، وَالنَّصِيحَةُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلُزُومُ جَمَاعَتِهِمْ، فَإِنَّ دَعْوَتَهُمْ تُحِيطُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, from his father, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “May God make radiant a servant who heard my words, memorized them, retained them, and conveyed them; for many a bearer of understanding is not himself a person of understanding, and many a bearer of understanding conveys it to one more understanding than he. Three things on which a Muslim's heart does not harbor rancor: sincerity of deed for God, sincere counsel for the Muslims, and adherence to their community, for their prayer encompasses those behind them.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَبَّلَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَوَجَدَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَجْدًا شَدِيدًا، فَأَرْسَلَ امْرَأَتَهُ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَدَخَلَتْ عَلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَأَخْبَرَتْهَا، فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَبِّلُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، فَرَجَعَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ، فَزَادَهُ ذَلِكَ شَرًّا وَقَالَ: لَسْنَا مِثْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يُحِلُّ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولِهِ مَا شَاءَ، فَرَجَعَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فَوَجَدَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا بَالُ هَذِهِ الْمَرْأَةِ؟» فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ فَقَالَ: «أَلَا أَخْبَرْتِهَا أَنِّي أَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ»، فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ: قَدْ أَخْبَرْتُهَا فَذَهَبَتْ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ فَزَادَهُ ذَلِكَ شَرًّا وَقَالَ: لَسْنَا مِثْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يُحِلُّ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولِهِ مَا شَاءَ، فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ: «وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَتْقَاكُمْ لِلَّهِ، وَأَعْلَمُكُمْ بِحُدُودِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from Zayd b. Aslam, from 'Ata' b. Yasar, that
entries.matn_en: a man kissed his wife while fasting and felt great anxiety about that, so he sent his wife to ask about it. She went to Umm Salama, Mother of the Believers, and told her, and Umm Salama said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ used to kiss while fasting.” The woman returned to her husband and told him, and it only increased his distress, and he said: “We are not like the Messenger of God ﷺ; God permits His Messenger what He wills.” The woman went back to Umm Salama and found the Messenger of God ﷺ with her. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “What is the matter with this woman?” Umm Salama told him, and he said: “Did you not tell her that I do that?” Umm Salama said: “I did tell her.” She had gone to her husband and told him, and it only increased his distress, and he said: “We are not like the Messenger of God ﷺ; God permits His Messenger what He wills.” The Messenger of God ﷺ became angry and then said: “By God, I am the most God-fearing of you, and the most knowledgeable of you of His limits.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ بِمِنًى إِذَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه عَلَى جَمَلٍ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ هَذِهِ أَيَّامُ طَعَامٍ وَشَرَابٍ، فَلَا ⦗ص: 241⦘ يَصُومَنَّ أَحَدٌ» فَاتَّبَعَ النَّاسَ وَهُوَ عَلَى جَمَلِهِ يَصْرُخُ فِيهِمْ بِذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Darawardi informed us, from Yazid b. al-Had, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Salama, from 'Amr b. Sulaym al-Zuraqi, from his mother, who said:
entries.matn_en: While we were at Mina, 'Ali b. Abi Talib ﵁ came on a camel saying: “The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘These are days of eating and drinking, so [p. 241] let none fast.’” He followed the people on his camel, crying this out to them.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ خَالٍ لَهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، يُقَالُ لَهُ يَزِيدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا فِي مَوْقِفٍ لَنَا بِعَرَفَةَ يُبَاعِدُهُ عَمْرٌو مِنْ مَوْقِفِ الْإِمَامِ جِدًّا، فَأَتَانَا ابْنُ مِرْبَعٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ لَنَا: إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْكُمْ، يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تَقِفُوا عَلَى مَشَاعِرِكُمْ هَذِهِ، فَإِنَّكُمْ عَلَى إِرْثٍ مِنْ إِرْثِ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from 'Amr b. 'Abd Allah b. Safwan, from a maternal uncle of his, God willing, called Yazid b. Shayban, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were at a standing place of ours at 'Arafa which 'Amr described as very far from the imam's standing place. Ibn Mirba' al-Ansari came to us and said: “I am the messenger of the Messenger of God ﷺ to you. He commands you to remain at these ritual sites of yours, for you are upon an inheritance from the inheritance of your father Ibrahim.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَعَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَضَى فِي الْإِبْهَامِ بِخَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ، وَفِي الَّتِي تَلِيهَا بِعَشْرٍ، وَفِي الَّتِي تَلِي الْخِنْصَرَ بِتِسْعٍ، وَفِي الْخِنْصَرِ بِسِتٍّ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan and 'Abd al-Wahhab al-Thaqafi informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ ruled fifteen [camels] for the thumb, ten for the finger next to it, nine for the one next to the little finger, and six for the little finger.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْأَلُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: {فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرَاهَا} [النازعات: 43] فَانْتَهَى
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ continued to be asked about the Hour until God revealed to him: {In what [position] are you that you should mention it?} [al-Nazi'at: 43], and he stopped.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، وَابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أُذَكِّرُ اللَّهَ امْرَءًا سَمِعَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْجَنِينِ شَيْئًا، فَقَامَ حَمَلُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّابِغَةِ فَقَالَ: «كُنْتُ بَيْنَ جَارَتَيْنِ لِي، يَعْنِي ضَرَّتَيْنِ، فَضَرَبَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِمِسْطَحٍ فَأَلْقَتْ جَنِينًا مَيِّتًا، فَقَضَى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِغُرَّةٍ»، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: لَوْ لَمْ نَسْمَعْ هَذَا لَقَضَيْنَا فِيهِ بِغَيْرِ هَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar and Ibn Tawus, from Tawus, that 'Umar said:
entries.matn_en: “I adjure by God any man who heard something from the Prophet ﷺ about the fetus.” Hamal b. Malik b. al-Nabigha stood and said: “I was between two neighbors of mine, meaning co-wives, and one of them struck the other with a tent-pole (mistah), and she miscarried a dead fetus. The Messenger of God ﷺ ruled a ghurra for it.” 'Umar said: “Had we not heard this, we would have ruled otherwise.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه إِنَّمَا رَجَعَ بِالنَّاسِ عَنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، يَعْنِي حِينَ خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَبَلَغَهُ وُقُوعُ الطَّاعُونِ بِهَا
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar ﵁ turned the people back only on the strength of the report of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf—that is, when he set out for Syria and word reached him that plague had broken out there.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ، زَيْنَبَ ⦗ص: 242⦘ بِنْتِ كَعْبٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْفُرَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ مَالِكِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ، أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّهَا، جَاءَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ تَرْجِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا فِي بَنِي خُدْرَةَ، فَإِنَّ زَوْجَهَا خَرَجَ فِي طَلَبِ أَعْبُدٍ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِطَرَفِ الْقَدُّومِ لَحِقَهُمْ فَقَتَلُوهُ فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِي؛ فَإِنَّ زَوْجِي لَمْ يَتْرُكْنِي فِي مَسْكَنٍ يَمْلِكُهُ، قَالَتْ: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «نَعَمْ». فَانْصَرَفْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنْتُ فِي الْحُجْرَةِ أَوْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ دَعَانِي، أَوْ أَمَرَ بِي فَدُعِيتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ: «كَيْفَ قُلْتِ». فَرَدَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْقِصَّةَ الَّتِي ذَكَرْتُ لَهُ مِنْ شَأْنِ زَوْجِي فَقَالَ: «امْكُثِي فِي بَيْتِكِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ». قَالَتْ: فَاعْتَدَدْتُ فِيهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُثْمَانُ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَّ فَسَأَلَنِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَاتَّبَعَهُ وَقَضَى بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Sa'd b. Ishaq b. Ka'b b. 'Ujra, from his paternal aunt Zaynab [p. 242] bint Ka'b, that
entries.matn_en: al-Furay'a bint Malik b. Sinan informed her that she came to the Prophet ﷺ asking him if she could return to her family among Banu Khudra, for her husband had gone out in pursuit of some slaves of his, and when he was at the edge of al-Qadum he caught up with them and they killed him. “I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ whether I could return to my family, since my husband had not left me in a house that he owned.” She said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Yes.” I left, and when I was in the room—or the mosque—he called me, or ordered that I be called, and said: “What did you say?” I repeated to him the story I had told him about my husband's situation. He said: “Stay in your house until the prescribed period reaches its end.” She said: So I observed in it a waiting period of four months and ten days. When 'Uthman [became caliph] he sent for me and asked me about that; I informed him, and he followed it and ruled by it.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: إِنَّ نَوْفًا الْبِكَالِيَّ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّ مُوسَى صَاحِبَ الْخَضِرِ لَيْسَ بِمُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: كَذَبَ عَدُوُّ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ قَالَ: خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ مُوسَى وَالْخَضِرِ بِشَيْءٍ يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّ مُوسَى صَاحِبُ الْخَضِرِ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Ibn 'Abbas: “Nawf al-Bikali claims that Musa, the companion of al-Khadir, is not the Musa of the Children of Israel.” Ibn 'Abbas said: “The enemy of God lied. Ubayy b. Ka'b informed me, saying: The Messenger of God ﷺ addressed us,” and then he related the report of Musa and al-Khadir in a manner indicating that Musa, companion of al-Khadir, [is the Musa of the Children of Israel].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ صَعْبٍ، أَنَّ طَاوُسًا، أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ، سَأَلَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ، بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ طَاوُسٌ: فَقُلْتُ: " مَا أَدَعُهُمَا، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: {مَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ} [الْأَحْزَاب: 36] "
entries.isnad_en: Muslim and 'Abd al-Majid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Amir b. Sa'b, that Tawus informed him that
entries.matn_en: he asked Ibn 'Abbas about the two rak'as after 'Asr, and he forbade him from them. Tawus said: “I said: ‘I will not leave them.’ Ibn 'Abbas [recited]: {It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when God and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should have any choice in their affair} [al-Ahzab: 36].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا نُخَابِرُ فَلَا نَرَى بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا حَتَّى زَعَمَ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهَا، فَتَرَكْنَاهَا مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: We used to practice mukhabara [sharecropping] and saw no harm in it, until Rafi' b. Khadij claimed that the Prophet ﷺ had forbidden it; so we abandoned it on that account.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي ⦗ص: 243⦘ سُفْيَانَ، بَاعَ سِقَايَةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ وَرِقٍ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ وَزْنِهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذَا، فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ: مَا أَرَى بِهَذَا بَأْسًا، فَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: مَنْ يَعْذِرُنِي مِنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ؟ أُخْبِرُهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَيُخْبِرُنِي عَنْ رَأْيِهِ لَا أُسَاكِنُكَ بِأَرْضٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Zayd b. Aslam, from 'Ata' b. Yasar, that
entries.matn_en: Mu'awiya b. Abi [p. 243] Sufyan sold a drinking vessel (siqaya) of gold or silver for more than its weight. Abu al-Darda' said to him: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ forbid the like of this.” Mu'awiya said: “I see no harm in this.” Abu al-Darda' said: “Who will excuse me against Mu'awiya? I inform him from the Messenger of God ﷺ and he informs me of his opinion! I will not live with you in one land.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ لَا أَتَّهِمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْلَدُ بْنُ خُفَافٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ابْتَعْتُ غُلَامًا فَاسْتَغْلَلْتُهُ ثُمَّ ظَهَرْتُ مِنْهُ عَلَى عَيْبٍ فَخَاصَمَتْ فِيهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَضَى لِي بِرَدِّهِ، وَقَضَى عَلَيَّ بِرَدِّ غَلَّتِهِ، فَأَتَيْتُ عُرْوَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ: أَرَوِحْ إِلَيْهِ الْعَشِيَّةَ فَأَخْبِرْهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا أَنَّ الْخَرَاجَ بِالضَّمَانِ، فَعَجِلْتُ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ مَا أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «فَمَا أَيْسَرَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتُهُ، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنِّي لَمْ أُرِدْ فِيهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ، فَبَلَغَتْنِي فِيهِ سُنَّةٌ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرُدُّ قَضَاءَ عُمَرَ وَأُنَفِّذُ سُنَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»، فَرَاحَ إِلَيْهِ عُرْوَةُ فَقَضَى لِي أَنْ آخُذَ الْخَرَاجَ مِنَ الَّذِي قَضَى بِهِ عَلَيَّ لَهُ
entries.isnad_en: One whom I do not doubt informed me, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b: Makhlad b. Khufaf informed me, saying:
entries.matn_en: I bought a slave and used him for income, then I found a defect in him. I brought the dispute to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, who ruled in my favor to return him, and ruled against me to return his earnings. I went to 'Urwa and told him, and he said: “Go to him this evening and tell him that 'A'isha informed me that the Messenger of God ﷺ ruled in a case like this that the yield goes with liability (al-kharaj bi-l-daman).” I hurried to 'Umar and told him what 'Urwa had told me from 'A'isha from the Prophet ﷺ. 'Umar said: “How easy it is for me to reverse a judgment I made! God knows I intended only the truth in it, but a sunna from the Messenger of God ﷺ has reached me about it; so I reverse 'Umar's judgment and enforce the sunna of the Messenger of God ﷺ.” 'Urwa went to him that evening, and he ruled that I take the yield from the one in whose favor he had ruled against me.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ بْنُ سِمَاكِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ الْيَمَانِيُّ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْكَعْبِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ: «مَنْ قُتِلَ لَهُ قَتِيلٌ فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ، إِنْ أَحَبَّ أَخَذَ الْعَقْلَ، وَإِنْ أَحَبَّ فَلَهُ الْقَوَدُ» فَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: فَقُلْتُ لِابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ: أَتَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا يَا أَبَا الْحَارِثِ؟ فَضَرَبَ صَدْرِي وَصَاحَ عَلَيَّ صِيَاحًا كَثِيرًا وَنَالَ مِنِّي وَقَالَ: أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقُولُ: تَأْخُذُ بِهِ نَعَمْ آخُذُ بِهِ، وَذَلِكَ الْفَرْضُ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى مَنْ سَمِعَهُ. إِنَّ اللَّهَ عز وجل اخْتَارَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ النَّاسِ فَهَدَاهُمْ بِهِ وَعَلَى يَدَيْهِ، اخْتَارَ لَهُمْ مَا اخْتَارَ لَهُ عَلَى لِسَانِهِ، فَعَلَى الْخَلْقِ أَنْ يَتَّبِعُوهُ طَائِعِينَ أَوْ دَاخِرِينَ، لَا مَخْرَجَ لِمُسْلِمٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ. قَالَ: وَمَا سَكَتَ عَنِّي حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ يَسْكُتَ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifa b. Simak b. al-Fadl al-Yamani informed me, saying: Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to me, from al-Maqburi, from Abu Shurayh al-Ka'bi, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said in the year of the Conquest: “Whoever has a relative killed has the better of two options: if he wishes he takes the blood-money, and if he wishes he has retaliation.” Abu Hanifa said: I said to Ibn Abi Dhi'b: “Do you hold to this, Abu al-Harith?” He struck my chest and shouted at me a great deal and berated me, and said: “I narrate to you from the Messenger of God ﷺ and you say ‘Do you hold to it?’ Yes, I hold to it, and that is an obligation upon me and upon whoever hears it. God Almighty chose Muhammad ﷺ from among mankind and guided them through him and at his hands; He chose for them what He chose for him, upon his tongue; so it is upon creation to follow him, willingly or in submission; there is no way out of that for a Muslim.” He said: “And he did not stop until I wished he would stop.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ رَجُلًا ضَحِكَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ الْوُضُوءَ وَالصَّلَاةَ " فَلَمْ نَقْبَلْ هَذَا لِأَنَّهُ مُرْسَلٌ أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
entries.isnad_en: The trustworthy one informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Ibn Shihab, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded a man who had laughed during the prayer to repeat the ablution and the prayer. We did not accept this because it is a mursal report. The trustworthy one informed us, from 'Umar, from Ibn Shihab, from Sulayman b. Arqam, from al-Hasan, from the Prophet ﷺ, with this hadith.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي لَبِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَامَ بِالْجَابِيَةِ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ فِينَا كَقِيَامِي فِيكُمْ فَقَالَ: «أَكْرِمُوا أَصْحَابِي، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ يَظْهَرُ الْكَذِبُ حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لِيَحْلِفُ وَلَا يُسْتَحْلَفُ، وَيَشْهَدُ وَلَا يُسْتَشْهَدُ، أَلَا فَمَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَسْكُنَ بُحْبُوحَةَ الْجَنَّةِ فَلْيَلْزَمِ الْجَمَاعَةَ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ مَعَ الْفَذِّ، وَهُوَ مِنَ الِاثْنَيْنِ أَبْعَدُ، وَلَا يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ ثَالِثُهُمَا، وَمَنْ سَرَّتْهُ حَسَنَتُهُ وَسَاءَتْهُ سَيِّئَتُهُ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Labid, from the son of Sulayman b. Yasar, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ stood at al-Jabiya delivering a sermon and said: The Messenger of God ﷺ stood among us as I stand among you and said: “Honor my Companions, then those who follow them, then those who follow them; then falsehood will appear, such that a man will swear without being asked to swear and testify without being asked to testify. Whoever delights in dwelling in the midst of Paradise, let him adhere to the community, for Satan is with the lone individual, and from two he is further away. Let no man be alone with a woman, for Satan is the third of them. And whoever is pleased by his good deed and distressed by his evil deed is a believer.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ، وَضَعَتْ، بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِلَيَالٍ، فَمَرَّ بِهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ بْنُ بَعْكَكٍ فَقَالَ: قَدْ تَصَنَّعْتِ لِلْأَزْوَاجِ إِنَّهَا أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ سُبَيْعَةُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «كَذَبَ أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ، أَوْ لَيْسَ كَمَا قَالَ أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ، قَدْ حَلَلْتِ فَتَزَوَّجِي»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: Subay'a bint al-Harith gave birth a few nights after the death of her husband. Abu al-Sanabil b. Ba'kak passed by her and said: “You have adorned yourself for husbands; [the waiting period] is four months and ten days.” Subay'a mentioned that to the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: “Abu al-Sanabil lied”—or: “It is not as Abu al-Sanabil said—you have become free; marry.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ، مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا حَكَمَ الْحَاكِمُ فَاجْتَهَدَ فَأَصَابَ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَإِذَا حَكَمَ فَاجْتَهَدَ فَأَخْطَأَ فَلَهُ أَجْرٌ» ⦗ص: 245⦘ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْهَادِ قَالَ: فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، فَقَالَ: هَكَذَا حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from Yazid b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Had, from Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Taymi, from Busr b. Sa'id, from Abu Qays, client of 'Amr b. al-'As, from 'Amr b. al-'As, that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: “When a judge rules, exerting his best judgment (ijtihad), and is correct, he has two rewards; and when he rules, exerting his best judgment, and errs, he has one reward.” [p. 245] 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from Yazid b. al-Had, who said: I narrated this hadith to Abu Bakr b. Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Hazm, and he said: “So Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to me, from Abu Hurayra ﵁.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of Dowry and Īlāʾ

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْهَادِي، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها: كَمْ كَانَ صَدَاقُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَتْ: " كَانَ صَدَاقُهُ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً وَنَشًّا، قَالَتْ: أَتَدْرِي مَا النَّشُّ؟ قُلْتُ: لَا، قَالَتْ: نِصْفُ أُوقِيَّةٍ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from Yazid b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Had, from Muhammad b. Ibrahim, from Abu Salama, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked 'A'isha ﵂: “How much was the dowry of the Prophet ﷺ?” She said: “His dowry for his wives was twelve uqiyas and a nashsh. Do you know what a nashsh is?” I said: “No.” She said: “Half an uqiya.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ أَسْهَمَ النَّاسُ الْمَنَازِلَ، فَطَارَ سَهْمُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعْدٌ: تَعَالَ حَتَّى أُقَاسِمَكَ مَالِي، وَأَنْزِلَ لَكَ عَنْ أَيِّ امْرَأَتَيَّ شِئْتَ، وَأَكْفِيَكَ الْعَمَلَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، دُلُّونِي عَلَى السُّوقِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ فَأَصَابَ شَيْئًا، فَخَطَبَ امْرَأَةً فَتَزَوَّجَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عَلَى كَمْ تَزَوَّجْتَهَا يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ؟» قَالَ: عَلَى نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَقَالَ: «أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Humayd al-Tawil, from Anas b. Malik ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: when the Messenger of God ﷺ arrived in Medina, the people drew lots for dwellings, and the lot of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf fell upon Sa'd b. al-Rabi'. Sa'd said to him: “Come, let me share my property with you, and I will give up for you whichever of my two wives you wish, and I will spare you the work.” 'Abd al-Rahman said to him: “May God bless you in your family and property; show me the market.” He went out to it and made some gain, then proposed to a woman and married her. The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “For how much did you marry her, 'Abd al-Rahman?” He said: “For a date-stone's weight of gold.” He said: “Hold a wedding feast, even with a single sheep.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ رضي الله عنه جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِهِ أَثَرُ صُفْرَةٍ، فَسَأَلَهُ رَسُولُ ⦗ص: 247⦘ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «كَمْ سُقْتَ إِلَيْهَا؟» قَالَ: زِنَةَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Humayd al-Tawil, from Anas b. Malik ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf ﵁ came to the Prophet ﷺ with a trace of yellow [perfume] on him, and the Messenger [p. 247] of God ﷺ asked him, and he informed him that he had married a woman of the Ansar. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “How much did you give her?” He said: “The weight of a date-stone in gold.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “Hold a wedding feast, even with a single sheep.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي قَدْ وَهَبْتُ نَفْسِي لَكَ، فَقَامَتْ قِيَامًا طَوِيلًا، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، زَوِّجْنِيهَا إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ بِهَا حَاجَةٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ تُصْدِقُهَا إِيَّاهُ؟» فَقَالَ: مَا عِنْدِي إِلَّا إِزَارِي هَذَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنْ أَعْطَيْتَهَا إِيَّاهُ جَلَسْتَ لَا إِزَارَ لَكَ، فَالْتَمِسْ شَيْئًا». فَقَالَ: مَا أَجِدُ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: «الْتَمِسْ وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ». فَالْتَمَسَ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ شَيْءٌ؟» قَالَ: نَعَمْ، سُورَةُ كَذَا وَسُورَةُ كَذَا، السُّوَرُ سَمَّاهَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قَدْ زَوَّجْتُكَهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: a woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of God, I have offered myself to you.” She stood for a long time. A man stood and said: “O Messenger of God, marry her to me if you have no need of her.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Do you have anything to give her as a dowry?” He said: “I have nothing except this waist-wrapper of mine.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “If you give it to her you will sit with no waist-wrapper; so look for something.” He said: “I find nothing.” He said: “Look, even for an iron ring.” He looked and found nothing. The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “Do you have anything of the Qur'an?” He said: “Yes—such-and-such a sura and such-and-such a sura,” naming the suras. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “I have married her to you for what you have of the Qur'an.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَةَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَأُمَّهَا بِنْتُ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، كَانَتْ تَحْتَ ابْنٍ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَمَاتَ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ لَهَا صَدَاقًا، فَابْتَغَتْ أُمُّهَا صَدَاقَهَا، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «لَيْسَ لَهَا صَدَاقٌ، وَلَوْ كَانَ لَهَا صَدَاقٌ لَمْ نَمْنَعْكُمُوهُ وَلَمْ نَظْلِمْهَا»، فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ ذَلِكَ، فَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، فَقَضَى أَنْ لَا صَدَاقَ لَهَا، وَلَهَا الْمِيرَاثُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', that
entries.matn_en: the daughter of 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Amr—whose mother was a daughter of Zayd b. al-Khattab—was married to a son of 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who died without consummating the marriage and without having named a dowry for her. Her mother sought her dowry, and Ibn 'Umar said: “She has no dowry; had she had a dowry, we would not have withheld it from you nor wronged her.” She refused to accept that, so they made Zayd b. Thabit arbiter between them, and he ruled that she has no dowry, and that she has the inheritance.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْمِسْوَرِ، عَنْ وَاصِلِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا حَتَّى طَلَّقَهَا، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا بِالصَّدَاقِ تَامًّا، فَقِيلَ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: «أَنَا أَوْلَى بِالْفَضْلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Fudayk and Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Ja'far b. al-Miswar, from Wasil b. Abi Sa'id, from Muhammad b. Jubayr b. Mut'im, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: he married a woman and did not consummate the marriage until he divorced her, and he sent her the dowry in full. He was asked about that and said: “I am more deserving of generosity.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عُقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ ⦗ص: 248⦘ الزَّوْجُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Wahhab informed us, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The one in whose hand is the knot of marriage [p. 248] is the husband.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عُقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ الزَّوْجُ
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Abi Mulayka, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, that he said:
entries.matn_en: The one in whose hand is the knot of marriage is the husband.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «هُوَ الزَّوْجُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, that
entries.matn_en: it reached him from Ibn al-Musayyab that he said: “It is the husband.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَدْرَكْتُ بَضْعَةَ عَشَرَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلُّهُمْ يُوقِفُ الْمُولِي»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sulayman b. Yasar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I met more than ten of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ, all of whom would have the man who has sworn ila' [to abstain from his wife] made to stand [for a decision].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «شَهِدْتُ عَلِيًّا رضي الله عنه أَوْقَفَ الْمُولِيَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Amr b. Salama, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I witnessed 'Ali ﵁ have the man who had sworn ila' made to stand [for a decision].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا رضي الله عنه أَوْقَفَ الْمُولِيَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Layth, from Mujahid, from Marwan b. al-Hakam, that
entries.matn_en: 'Ali ﵁ had the man who had sworn ila' made to stand [for a decision].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنه كَانَ يُوقِفُ الْمُولِيَ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Mis'ar, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Tawus, that
entries.matn_en: 'Uthman ﵁ used to have the man who had sworn ila' made to stand [for a decision].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضي الله عنها إِذَا ذُكِرَ لَهَا الرَّجُلُ يَحْلِفُ أَنْ لَا يَأْتِيَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَيَدَعَهَا خَمْسَةَ أَشْهُرٍ لَا تَرَى ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يُوقَفَ، وَتَقُولُ: " كَيْفَ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: {إِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ} "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad, who said:
entries.matn_en: When a man was mentioned to 'A'isha ﵂ who swears not to approach his wife and leaves her five months, she did not regard that as anything until he is made to stand [for a decision], and she would say: “How did God Almighty put it: {retention in a proper manner or release with kindness}?”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا آلَى الرَّجُلُ مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ لَمْ يَقَعْ عَلَيْهَا طَلَاقٌ وَإِنْ مَضَتْ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ حَتَّى يُوقَفَ، فَإِمَّا أَنْ يُطَلِّقَ، وَإِمَّا أَنَّ يَفِيءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “When a man swears ila' against his wife, no divorce takes effect on her even if four months pass, until he is made to stand [for a decision]: either he divorces, or he returns [to her].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا رضي الله عنه كَانَ يُوقِفُ الْمُولِيَ وَسَمِعْتُ الرَّبِيعَ بْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أَسَدَ بْنَ مُوسَى يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ: «اسْتُتِيبَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ» وَسَمِعْتُ الرَّبِيعَ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّافِعِيَّ يَقُولُ: «طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ النَّافِلَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: 'Ali ﵁ used to have the man who had sworn ila' made to stand [for a decision]. And I heard al-Rabi' b. Sulayman say: I heard Asad b. Musa narrate, saying: “Abu Hanifa was asked to repent twice.” And I heard al-Rabi' say: I heard al-Shafi'i say: “Seeking knowledge is better than voluntary prayer.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of Currency Exchange (Ṣarf)

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ أَبِي بَزَّةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَوَجَدْتُ جَزُورًا قَدْ نُحِرَتْ فَجُزِّئَتْ أَجْزَاءً، كُلُّ جُزْءٍ مِنْهَا بِعَنَاقٍ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَاعَ مِنْهَا جُزْءًا فَقَالَ لِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُبَاعَ حَيٌّ بِمَيِّتٍ. قَالَ: فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ فَأُخْبِرْتُ عَنْهُ خَيْرًا "
entries.isnad_en: Muslim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from al-Qasim b. Abi Bazza, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I came to Medina and found a camel that had been slaughtered and divided into portions, each portion [priced] at a young goat ('anaq). I wanted to buy a portion of it, and a man of the people of Medina said to me: ‘The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade selling a living animal for a dead one.’” He said: “I asked about that man and was told good of him.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، مَوْلَى التَّوْأَمَةِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ بَيْعَ اللَّحْمِ بِالْحَيَوَانِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Najih informed us, from Abu Salih, client of al-Taw'ama, from Ibn 'Abbas, from Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: he disliked selling meat for livestock.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Pledges and Leases

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يُغْلَقُ الرَّهْنُ الرَّهْنَ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ الَّذِي رَهَنَهُ، لَهُ غُنْمُهُ وَعَلَيْهِ غُرْمُهُ» وَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Isma'il informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “A pledge is not forfeited by the one who pledged it; its gain is his and its loss is his.” And more than one scholar has informed me, from Yahya b. Abi Unaysa, from Ibn Shihab, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same as the report of Ibn Abi Dhi'b.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَغَيْرُهُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهَنَ دِرْعَهُ عِنْدَ أَبِي الشَّحْمِ الْيَهُودِيِّ
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Muhammad and others informed us, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ pledged his coat of mail with Abu al-Shahm the Jew.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْأَرْضِ، فَقَالَ: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْأَرْضِ. فَقَالَ: بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ؟ قَالَ: أَمَّا بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Rabi'a b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman, from Hanzala b. Qays, that
entries.matn_en: he asked Rafi' b. Khadij about renting land. He said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade renting land.” He said: “With gold and silver?” He said: “As for gold and silver, there is no harm in it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ اسْتِكْرَاءِ الْأَرْضِ، بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ فَقَالَ: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، شَبِيهًا بِهِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، بِمِثْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that
entries.matn_en: he asked him about renting land for gold and silver, and he said: “There is no harm in it.” Malik informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, something similar. Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, the same.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ غَرْقَدَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْحَيَّ، يُحَدِّثُونَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَاهُ دِينَارًا لِيَشْتَرِيَ لَهُ بِهِ شَاةً أَوْ أُضْحِيَّةً، فَاشْتَرَى لَهُ شَاتَيْنِ فَبَاعَ إِحْدَاهُمَا بِدِينَارٍ وَأَتَاهُ بِشَاةٍ وَدِينَارٍ، فَدَعَى لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْعِهِ بِالْبَرَكَةِ، فَكَانَ لَوِ اشْتَرَى تُرَابًا لَرَبِحَ فِيهِ قَالَ: وَقَدْ رَوَى هَذَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ غَرْقَدَةَ فَوَصَلَهُ، وَيَرْوِيهِ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ بِمِثْلِ هَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ أَوْ مَعْنَاهَا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from Shabib b. Gharqada, that he heard the clan narrating from 'Urwa b. Abi al-Ja'd that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ gave him a dinar to buy him a sheep or a sacrificial animal. He bought him two sheep, sold one of them for a dinar, and came to him with a sheep and a dinar. The Messenger of God ﷺ prayed for blessing on his sale, so that had he bought dust he would have profited from it. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna also narrated this from Shabib b. Gharqada in connected form, narrating it from 'Urwa b. Abi al-Ja'd with this same story or its meaning.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، وَعُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ، ابْنَيْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ خَرَجَا فِي جَيْشٍ إِلَى الْعِرَاقِ فَلَمَّا قَفَلَا مَرَّا بِعَامِلٍ لِعُمَرَ فَرَحَّبَ بِهِمَا وَسَهَّلَ، وَهُوَ أَمِيرُ الْبَصْرَةِ، وَقَالَ: لَوْ أَقْدِرُ لَكُمَا عَلَى أَمْرٍ أَنْفَعُكُمَا بِهِ لَفَعَلْتُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: بَلَى، هَاهُنَا مَالٌ مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَبْعَثَ بِهِ إِلَى أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَأُسْلِفُكُمَاهُ فَتَبْتَاعَانِ بِهِ مَتَاعًا مِنْ مَتَاعِ الْعِرَاقِ، ثُمَّ تَبِيعَانِهِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَتُؤَدِّيَانِ رَأْسَ الْمَالِ إِلَى أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَكُونُ لَكُمَا الرِّبْحُ، فَقَالَا: وَدِدْنَا، فَفَعَلَ، فَكَتَبَ لَهُمَا إِلَى عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِنْهُمَا الْمَالَ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَا الْمَدِينَةَ بَاعَا فَرَبِحَا، فَلَمَّا دَفَعَاهُ إِلَى عُمَرَ قَالَ لَهُمَا: «أَكُلَّ الْجَيْشِ قَدْ أَسْلَفَهُ كَمَا أَسْلَفَكُمَا»؟ فَقَالَا: لَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: ابْنَا أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَأَسْلَفَكُمَا، أَدِّيَا الْمَالَ وَرِبْحَهُ، فَأَمَّا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَسَكَتَ، وَأَمَّا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ: مَا يَنْبَغِي لَكَ هَذَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، لَوْ هَلَكَ هَذَا الْمَالُ أَوْ نَقَصَ لَضَمِنَّاهُ، فَقَالَ: أَدِّيَاهُ، فَسَكَتَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَاجَعَهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَاءِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، لَوْ جَعَلْتَهُ قِرَاضًا، فَأَخَذَ عُمَرُ رَأْسَ الْمَالِ وَنِصْفَ رِبْحِهِ، وَأَخَذَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ نِصْفَ رِبْحِ ذَلِكَ الْمَالِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Zayd b. Aslam, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah and 'Ubayd Allah, sons of 'Umar b. al-Khattab, set out with an army to Iraq, and on their return they passed by an agent of 'Umar's, who welcomed them warmly and made things easy for them; he was the governor of Basra. He said: “If I could arrange something for you that would benefit you, I would do it.” Then he said: “Indeed, here is some money from God's money that I intend to send to the Commander of the Faithful; I will lend it to you, and you can buy with it goods of Iraq, then sell them in Medina, and pay the principal to the Commander of the Faithful, and the profit will be yours.” They said: “We would like that.” He did so, and wrote to 'Umar ﵁ to take the money from them. When they reached Medina they sold and made a profit. When they handed it over to 'Umar, he said to them: “Did he lend the entire army the same as he lent you?” They said: “No.” 'Umar ﵁ said: “The two sons of the Commander of the Faithful, so he lent you [this]! Pay back the principal and its profit.” 'Abd Allah was silent, but 'Ubayd Allah said: “This is not fitting for you, O Commander of the Faithful; had this money been lost or diminished, we would have been liable for it.” He said: “Pay it back.” 'Abd Allah remained silent and 'Ubayd Allah argued with him. A man among 'Umar's ﵁ companions said: “O Commander of the Faithful, what if you made it a qirad [profit-sharing partnership]?” So 'Umar took the principal and half of its profit, and 'Abd Allah and 'Ubayd Allah took half of the profit of that money.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Shighār Marriage

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الشِّغَارِ وَالشِّغَارُ: أَنْ يُزَوِّجَ الرَّجُلُ ابْنَتَهُ عَلَى أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ الْآخَرُ ابْنَتَهُ وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا صَدَاقٌ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade shighar. Shighar is when a man gives his daughter in marriage on condition that the other gives him his daughter in marriage, with no dowry between them.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الشِّغَارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Majid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj: Abu al-Zubayr informed us that he heard Jabir b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ forbade shighar.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا شِغَارَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no shighar in Islam.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، أَخِي بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَرَادَ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَ، طَلْحَةَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بِنْتَ شَيْبَةَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ لِيَحْضُرَ ذَلِكَ وَهُمَا مُحْرِمَانِ، فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ أَبَانُ وَقَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يَنْكِحُ الْمُحْرِمُ، وَلَا يُنْكِحُ، وَلَا يَخْطُبُ» ⦗ص: 254⦘ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', client of Ibn 'Umar, from Nubayh b. Wahb, of Banu 'Abd al-Dar, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. 'Ubayd Allah wanted to marry Talha b. 'Umar to the daughter of Shayba b. Jubayr, and sent to Aban b. 'Uthman to attend that, while both were in ihram. Aban objected to that and said: I heard 'Uthman b. 'Affan ﵁ say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “A person in ihram does not marry, nor give another in marriage, nor propose.” [p. 254] Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ayyub b. Musa, from Nubayh b. Wahb, from Aban b. 'Uthman, from 'Uthman b. 'Affan ﵁, from the Prophet ﷺ, with a similar meaning.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَبَا رَافِعٍ مَوْلَاهُ وَرَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَزَوَّجَاهُ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ وَهُوَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Rabi'a, from Sulayman b. Yasar, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ sent Abu Rafi', his client, and a man of the Ansar, and they married Maymuna bint al-Harith to him while he was in Medina before setting out.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ أُخْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَكَحَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَهُوَ حَلَالٌ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr, from Yazid b. al-Asamm, who was Maymuna's nephew [sister's son], that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ married Maymuna while he was not in ihram.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَوْهَمَ الَّذِي رَوَى أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَكَحَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ، مَا نَكَحَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا وَهُوَ حَلَالٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Maslama informed us, from Isma'il b. Umayya, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The one who narrated that the Messenger of God ﷺ married Maymuna while in ihram was mistaken; the Messenger of God ﷺ married her only when he was not in ihram.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِي غَطَفَانَ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ الْمُرِّيِّ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ طَرِيفًا تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَرَدَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ نِكَاحَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Dawud b. al-Husayn, from Abu Ghatafan b. Tarif al-Murri, that he informed him that
entries.matn_en: his father Tarif married a woman while in ihram, and 'Umar b. al-Khattab annulled his marriage.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَنْكِحُ الْمُحْرِمُ، وَلَا يُنْكِحُ، وَلَا يَخْطُبُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَلَا عَلَى غَيْرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: “A person in ihram does not marry, nor give another in marriage, nor propose, whether for himself or for another.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَسَنِ، ابْنَيْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ: وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ أَرْضَاهُمَا، عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنهم وَأَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَسَنِ، ابْنَيْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ⦗ص: 255⦘ ، وَعَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْإِنْسِيَّةِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abd Allah and al-Hasan, sons of Muhammad b. 'Ali—he said: and al-Hasan was the more satisfactory of the two—from their father, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib ﵃. And Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Abd Allah and al-Hasan, sons of Muhammad b. 'Ali, from their father, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the temporary marriage (mut'a) of women on the day of Khaybar [p. 255], and the eating of the meat of domestic donkeys.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ نِكَاحِ الْمُتْعَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from al-Rabi' b. Sabra, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ forbade temporary marriage (nikah al-mut'a).

sections.title_en: From the Book of Ẓihār and Liʿān

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا الْعَجْلَانِيَّ جَاءَ إِلَى عَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَرَأَيْتَ يَا عَاصِمُ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلًا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ؟ سَلْ لِي يَا عَاصِمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَسَأَلَ عَاصِمٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسَائِلَ وَعَابَهَا حَتَّى كَبُرَ عَلَى عَاصِمٍ مَا سَمِعَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ عَاصِمٌ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ جَاءَهُ عُوَيْمِرٌ فَقَالَ: يَا عَاصِمُ، مَاذَا قَالَ لَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ لِعُوَيْمِرٍ: لَمْ تَأْتِنِي بِخَيْرٍ، قَدْ كَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْأَلَةَ الَّتِي سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا، فَقَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ: وَاللَّهِ لَا أَنْتَهِي حَتَّى أَسْأَلَهُ عَنْهَا، فَأَقْبَلَ عُوَيْمِرٌ حَتَّى أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَطَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ وَفِي صَاحِبَتِكَ، فَاذْهَبْ فَأْتِ بِهَا». فَقَالَ سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ: فَتَلَاعَنَا، وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا مِنْ تَلَاعُنِهِمَا قَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ: كَذَبْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا، فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ سُنَّةُ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, saying: Ibn Shihab narrated to me that Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi informed him that
entries.matn_en: 'Uwaymir al-'Ajlani came to 'Asim b. 'Adi al-Ansari and said to him: “What do you think, 'Asim: if a man found another man with his wife, should he kill him, so that you kill him [in retaliation], or what should he do? Ask the Messenger of God ﷺ about this for me, 'Asim.” 'Asim asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about it, and the Messenger of God ﷺ disliked such questions and criticized them, until what 'Asim heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ weighed heavily on him. When 'Asim returned to his family, 'Uwaymir came to him and said: “'Asim, what did the Messenger of God ﷺ say to you?” 'Asim said to 'Uwaymir: “You did not bring me any good; the Messenger of God ﷺ disliked the question I asked him about.” 'Uwaymir said: “By God, I will not stop until I ask him about it.” 'Uwaymir went until he came to the Messenger of God ﷺ in the midst of the people and said: “O Messenger of God, what do you think of a man who finds another man with his wife—should he kill him, so that you kill him, or what should he do?” The Prophet ﷺ said: “God has revealed [a ruling] concerning you and your wife. Go and bring her.” Sahl b. Sa'd said: So they performed li'an while I was with the people at the Messenger of God's ﷺ place. When they had finished their li'an, 'Uwaymir said: “I would have lied against her, O Messenger of God, if I kept her,” and he divorced her three times before the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded him. Ibn Shihab said: That became the practice for those who perform li'an.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ عُوَيْمِرٌ الْعَجْلَانِيُّ إِلَى عَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ فَقَالَ: يَا عَاصِمَ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ، سَلْ لِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ رَجُلٍ وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا فَيَقْتُلُهُ، أَيُقْتَلُ بِهِ أَمْ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ؟ فَسَأَلَ عَاصِمٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَعَابَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسَائِلَ، فَلَقِيَهُ عُوَيْمِرٌ فَقَالَ: مَا صَنَعْتَ؟ قَالَ: صَنَعْتُ إِنَّكَ لَمْ تَأْتِنِي بِخَيْرٍ، سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَابَ الْمَسَائِلَ، فَقَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ: وَاللَّهِ لَآتِيَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَأَسْأَلَنَّهُ، فَأَتَاهُ فَوَجَدَهُ قَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهِمَا، فَدَعَاهُمَا فَلَاعَنَ بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ: لَإِنِ انْطَلَقْتُ بِهَا لَقَدْ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا، فَفَارَقَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم. قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «انْظُرُوهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَسْحَمَ، أَدْعَجَ، عَظِيمَ الْإِلْيَتَيْنِ فَلَا أُرَاهُ إِلَّا قَدْ صَدَقَ، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أُحَيْمِرَ كَأَنَّهُ وَحَرَةٌ فَلَا أُرَاهُ إِلَّا كَاذِبًا». فَجَاءَتْ بِهِ عَلَى النَّعْتِ الْمَكْرُوهِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: فَصَارَتْ سُنَّةُ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Sa'd informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl b. Sa'd, who informed him, saying:
entries.matn_en: 'Uwaymir al-'Ajlani came to 'Asim b. 'Adi and said: “'Asim b. 'Adi, ask the Messenger of God ﷺ for me about a man who finds another man with his wife and kills him: is he killed for it, or what should he do?” 'Asim asked the Prophet ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ criticized such questions. 'Uwaymir met him and said: “What did you do?” He said: “I did it; you brought me no good. I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ and he criticized the questions.” 'Uwaymir said: “By God, I will go to the Messenger of God ﷺ and ask him.” He came to him and found that [a revelation] had been sent down to him concerning them both. He summoned them and had them perform li'an. 'Uwaymir said: “If I take her away, I will have lied against her,” and he separated from her before the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded him. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Watch her. If she brings it [the child] dark, with large dark eyes and large buttocks, I think only that he has spoken truly; and if she brings it reddish like a lizard (wahara), I think only that he lied.” She brought it in the disliked description. Ibn Shihab said: So it became the practice for those who perform li'an.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا، جَاءَ إِلَى عَاصِمٍ فَقَالَ: أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلًا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا فَقَتَلَهُ، أَتَقْتُلُونَهُ؟ سَلْ لِي يَا عَاصِمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسَائِلَ وَعَابَهَا، فَرَجَعَ عَاصِمٌ إِلَى عُوَيْمِرٍ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَرِهَ الْمَسَائِلَ وَعَابَهَا، فَقَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ: وَاللَّهِ لَآتِيَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَجَاءَ وَقَدْ نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ خِلَافَ عَاصِمٍ، فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «قَدْ نَزَلَ فِيكُمَا الْقُرْآنُ». فَتَقَدَّمَا فَتَلَاعَنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ: كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا، فَفَارَقَهَا وَمَا أَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمَضَتْ سُنَّةُ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ. وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «انْظُرُوهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أُحَيْمِرَ قَصِيرًا كَأَنَّهُ وَحَرَةٌ فَلَا أَحْسِبُهُ إِلَّا قَدْ كَذَبَ عَلَيْهَا، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَسْحَمَ، أَعْيَنَ، ذَا أَلْيَتَيْنِ، فَلَا أَحْسِبُهُ إِلَّا قَدْ صَدَقَ عَلَيْهَا». فَجَاءَتْ بِهِ عَلَى النَّعْتِ الْمَكْرُوهِ. سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: إِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَشْقَرَ سَبِطًا ⦗ص: 258⦘ فَهُوَ لِزَوْجِهَا، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أُدَيْعِجَ فَهُوَ لِلَّذِي يَتَّهِمُهُ ". قَالَ: فَجَاءَتْ بِهِ أُدَيْعِجَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. Nafi' informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl b. Sa'd, that
entries.matn_en: 'Uwaymir came to 'Asim and said: “What do you think: if a man found another man with his wife and killed him, would you kill him? Ask the Messenger of God ﷺ for me, 'Asim.” He asked the Prophet ﷺ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ disliked such questions and criticized them. 'Asim returned to 'Uwaymir and informed him that the Prophet ﷺ disliked such questions and criticized them. 'Uwaymir said: “By God, I will go to the Messenger of God ﷺ.” He came, and Qur'an had been revealed contrary to 'Asim's [expectation]. He asked the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: “Qur'an has been revealed concerning you both.” They came forward and performed li'an. Then he said: “I would have lied against her if I kept her,” and he separated from her without the Prophet ﷺ commanding him; so the practice of those who perform li'an proceeded. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Watch her. If she brings it reddish and short, like a lizard, I think only that he lied against her; and if she brings it dark, with [large] eyes and large buttocks, I think only that he spoke truly about her.” She brought it in the disliked description. I heard Ibrahim b. Sa'd narrate from his father, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab and 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Utba, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If she brings it blond and lank-haired [p. 258], it is her husband's; and if she brings it very dark-eyed, it belongs to the one he accuses.” He said: She brought it very dark-eyed.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَخِي بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ؟ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل فِي شَأْنِهِ مَا ذُكِرَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «قَدْ قُضِيَ فِيكَ وَفِي امْرَأَتِكَ». قَالَ: فَتَلَاعَنَا وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ ثُمَّ فَارَقَهَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكَانَتْ سُنَّةٌ بَعْدَهُمَا أَنْ يُفَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ، وَكَانَتْ حَامِلًا فَأَنْكَرَهَا، فَكَانَ ابْنُهَا يُدْعَى إِلَى أُمِّهِ
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl b. Sa'd, of Banu Sa'ida, that
entries.matn_en: a man of the Ansar came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of God, what do you think of a man who finds another man with his wife—should he kill him, so that you kill him, or what should he do?” So God Almighty revealed concerning his case what is mentioned in the Qur'an about those who perform li'an. He said: The Prophet ﷺ said to him: “A ruling has been made concerning you and your wife.” He said: They performed li'an while I was present, then he separated from her in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ. After them it became the practice that those who perform li'an are separated. She was pregnant and he denied [the child], so her son used to be called by his mother's name.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: شَهِدْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يُحَدِّثُ بِحَدِيثِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ شَدَّادٍ: أَهِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَوْ كُنْتُ رَاجِمًا أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ رَجَمْتُهَا»؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: لَا، تِلْكُ امْرَأَةٌ قَدْ أَعْلَنَتْ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was present when Ibn 'Abbas narrated the hadith of those who performed li'an, and Ibn Shaddad said to him: “Is she the one about whom the Prophet ﷺ said, ‘If I were to stone anyone without proof, I would stone her’?” Ibn 'Abbas said: “No; that was a woman who had made [her conduct] public.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْمَقْبُرِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ الْقُرَظِيَّ، قَالَ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ أَدْخَلَتْ عَلَى قَوْمٍ مَنْ لَيْسَ مِنْهُمْ فَلَيْسَتْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فِي شَيْءٍ، وَلَمْ يُدْخِلْهَا اللَّهُ جَنَّتَهُ، وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ جَحَدَ وَلَدَهُ وَهُوَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ احْتَجَبَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ وَفَضَحَهُ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلَائِقِ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muhammad informed us, from Ibn al-Had, from 'Abd Allah b. Yunus, that he heard al-Maqburi narrate to al-Qurazi. Al-Maqburi said: Abu Hurayra narrated to me that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say,
entries.matn_en: when the verse of li'an was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ said: “Any woman who brings into a people someone who is not of them has nothing from God, and God will not admit her to His Paradise; and any man who denies his child while looking at him, God will veil Himself from him and expose him before the heads of creation, among the earlier and later peoples.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِلْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ: «حِسَابُكُمَا عَلَى اللَّهِ، أَحَدُكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، لَا سَبِيلَ لَكَ عَلَيْهَا». قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَالِي، قَالَ: «لَا مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَدَقْتَ فَهُوَ بِمَا اسْتَحْلَلْتَ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَذَبْتَ عَلَيْهَا فَذَلِكَ أَبْعَدُ لَكَ مِنْهَا، أَوْ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And I heard Sufyan b. 'Uyayna say: 'Amr b. Dinar informed us, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ said to the couple who had performed li'an: “Your reckoning is with God; one of you is lying. You have no claim over her.” He said: “O Messenger of God, my property?” He said: “You have no property: if you spoke truly, it is in return for what you made lawful of her private parts; and if you lied against her, then that puts it further from you than from her.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: فَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْ بَنِي الْعَجْلَانِ، وَقَالَ: هَكَذَا، بِأُصْبُعَيْهِ الْمُسَبِّحَةِ وَالْوسْطَى، فَفَرَّقَهُمَا الْوسْطَى وَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا، يَعْنِي الْمُسَبِّحَةَ، وَقَالَ: «اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Ayyub, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: I heard Ibn 'Umar say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ separated the two siblings of Banu al-'Ajlan [the couple], and he said thus—with his two fingers, the index and the middle—separating them, the middle finger and the one next to it, meaning the index finger. And he said: “God knows that one of you is lying; is either of you repentant?”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، لَاعَنَ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي زَمَانِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَانْتَفَى مِنْ وَلَدِهَا، فَفَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمَا، وَأَلْحَقَ الْوَلَدَ بِالْمَرْأَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: a man performed li'an against his wife in the time of the Prophet ﷺ and disowned her child; so the Messenger of God ﷺ separated them and attached the child to the woman.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Khulʿ and Nushūz

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ، كَانَتْ عِنْدَ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ فَكَرِهَ مِنْهَا أَمْرًا، إِمَّا كِبْرًا أَوْ غَيْرَهُ، فَأَرَادَ طَلَاقَهَا فَقَالَتْ: «لَا تُطَلِّقْنِي، وَأَمْسِكْنِي، وَاقْسِمْ لِي مَا بَدَا لَكَ»، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: {وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا} [النِّسَاء: 128] الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, that
entries.matn_en: the daughter of Muhammad b. Maslama was married to Rafi' b. Khadij, and he disliked something in her, either her age or something else, and wished to divorce her. She said: “Do not divorce me; keep me, and apportion to me as you see fit.” So God Almighty revealed: {And if a woman fears from her husband ill conduct (nushuz)} [al-Nisa': 128], to the end of the verse.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُوُفِّيَ عَنْ تِسْعِ نِسْوَةٍ، وَكَانَ يَقْسِمُ لِثَمَانٍ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ died leaving nine wives, and he used to apportion [his nights] for eight.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تَزَوَّجَ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ وَأَصْبَحَتْ عِنْدَهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ بِكِ عَلَى أَهْلِكِ هَوَانٌ، إِنْ شِئْتِ سَبَّعْتُ عِنْدَكِ وَسَبَّعْتُ عِنْدَهُنَّ، وَإِنْ شِئْتِ ثَلَّثْتُ عِنْدَكِ وَدُرْتُ». قَالَتْ: ثَلِّثْ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr b. Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Hazm, from 'Abd al-Malik b. Abi Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman, that when the Messenger of God ﷺ married Umm Salama and she woke up in the morning with him, he said:
entries.matn_en: “You are not of low standing with your family. If you wish, I will spend seven nights with you and seven with each of them; and if you wish, I will spend three with you and then rotate.” She said: “Three.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ،
