And al-Hakam said in Matar's other hadith: “'Umar said: You have a right, but my knowledge does not reach — now that it has grown large — that all of it is yours. If you wish, I will give you of it as much as I think is yours.” But we refused anything except all of it, and he refused to give us all of it.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا أَحَدٌ إِلَّا وَلَهُ فِي هَذَا الْمَالِ حَقٌّ، أُعْطِيَهُ أَوْ مُنِعَهُ، إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ» أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه نَحْوَهُ وَقَالَ: لَئِنْ عِشْتُ لَيَأْتِيَنَّ الرَّاعِي بُسْرٌ وَحَمِيرٌ حَقَّهُ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from al-Zuhri, from Malik b. Aws, that 'Umar ﵁ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no one who does not have a right in this wealth, whether given or withheld, except what your right hands possess.” Ibrahim b. Muhammad informed us, from Muhammad b. al-Munkadir, from Malik b. Aws, from 'Umar ﵁ to the same effect, and he said: “If I live, the shepherd at Busr and Himyar [as transmitted] will come and receive his right.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ ⦗ص: 326⦘ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «عُرِضْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ أُحُدٍ وَأَنَا ابْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَرَدَّنِي، ثُمَّ عُرِضْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَامَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَأَنَا ابْنُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَأَجَازَنِي» قَالَ نَافِعٌ: فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالَ: هَذَا فَرْقٌ بَيْنَ الْمُقَاتِلَةِ وَالذُّرِّيَّةِ. وَكَتَبَ أَنْ يَفْرِضَ لِابْنِ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فِي الْمُقَاتِلَةِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَبْلُغْهَا فِي الذُّرِّيَّةِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, may God be pleased [p. 326] with them both, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I was presented to the Prophet ﷺ in the year of Uhud when I was fourteen years old, and he rejected me; then I was presented to him in the year of the Trench when I was fifteen years old, and he accepted me.” Nafi' said: I narrated this hadith to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, and he said: “This is the dividing line between fighters and offspring.” And he wrote that those of fifteen years be assigned stipends among the fighters, and those who had not reached it among the offspring.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه لَمَّا دَوَّنَ الدَّوَاوِينَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بِمَنْ تَرَوْنَ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ؟ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: ابْدَأْ بِالْأَقْرَبِ فَالْأَقْرَبِ بِكَ، قَالَ: بَلْ أَبْدَأُ بِالْأَقْرَبِ فَالْأَقْرَبِ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. 'Ali, that when 'Umar ﵁ compiled the registers (dawawin), he said:
entries.matn_en: “With whom do you think I should begin?” It was said to him: “Begin with those nearest to you, then the next nearest.” He said: “No — I will begin with those nearest to the Messenger of God ﷺ, then the next nearest.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of the Prophet’s Prohibitions and the Book of Posthumous Manumission
sections.title_ar: وَمِنْ كِتَابِ صِفَةِ نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكِتَابِ الْمُدَبَّرِ

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا مَذْكُورٍ، رَجُلًا مِنْ بَنِي عُذْرَةَ، كَانَ لَهُ غُلَامٌ قِبْطِيُّ فَأَعْتَقَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ، مِنْهُ، وَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ الْعَبْدِ فَبَاعَ الْعَبْدَ وَقَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِنَفْسِهِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ فَضْلٌ فَلْيَبْدَأْ مَعَ نَفْسِهِ بِمَنْ يَعُولُ، ثُمَّ إِنْ وَجَدَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَضْلًا فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَى غَيْرِهِمْ» وَزَادَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ فِي الْحَدِيثِ شَيْئًا
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid and 'Abd al-Majid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj: Abu al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jabir b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: Abu Madhkur, a man of the Banu 'Udhra, had a Coptic slave, and he freed him by tadbir (to take effect after his own death). The Prophet ﷺ heard about that slave and sold the slave, and said: “When one of you is poor, let him begin with himself; if there is a surplus, let him begin, along with himself, with those he supports; then if he finds a further surplus after that, let him give charity to others.” And Muslim b. Khalid added something to the hadith.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، أَعْتَقَ غُلَامًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي؟» فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِثَمَانِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، فَأَعْطَاهُ الثَّمَنَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Hassan informed us, from Hammad b. Zayd, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Jabir ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: a man freed a slave of his by tadbir, and he had no other property. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Who will buy him from me?” Nu'aym b. 'Abd Allah bought him for eight hundred dirhams, and [the Prophet] gave [the man] the price. Yahya b. Hassan informed us, from Hammad b. Salama, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ﵄, from the Prophet ﷺ, to the same effect.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، وَحَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ⦗ص: 328⦘ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عُذْرَةَ عَبْدًا عَنْ دُبُرٍ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «أَلَكَ مَالٌ غَيْرَهُ؟» فَقَالَ: لَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي؟» فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْعَدَوِيُّ بِثَمَانِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، فَجَاءَ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَفَعَهَا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «ابْدَأْ بِنَفْسِكَ فَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْهَا، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْ نَفْسِكِ شَيْءٌ فَلِأَهْلِكَ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ شَيْءٌ فَلِذَوِي قَرَابَتِكَ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْ ذَوِي قَرَابَتِكَ فَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا» يُرِيدُ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَشِمَالِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Hassan informed us, from al-Layth and Hammad b. Salama, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir [p. 328] ﵁, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man of the Banu 'Udhra freed a slave by tadbir, and that reached the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Do you have any property other than him?” He said: “No.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Who will buy him from me?” Nu'aym b. 'Abd Allah al-'Adawi bought him for eight hundred dirhams, and brought them to the Prophet ﷺ, who handed them to [the man] and then said: “Begin with yourself and give charity to it; if anything is left over from yourself, [give it] to your family; if anything is left over, [give it] to your relatives; and if anything is left over beyond your relatives, then thus and thus” — meaning on your right and on your left.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، وَعَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، سَمِعَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: دَبَّرَ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا غُلَامًا لَهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرَهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي؟» فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمٌ النَّحَّامُ قَالَ عَمْرٌو: فَسَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ: عَبْدًا قِبْطِيًّا مَاتَ عَامَ أَوَّلٍ فِي إِمَارَةِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ. وَزَادَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ: يُقَالُ لَهُ يَعْقُوبُ. قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رضي الله عنه: هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ عَامَّةَ دَهْرِي، ثُمَّ وَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي: دَبَّرَ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا غُلَامًا لَهُ فَمَاتَ. فَإِمَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ خَطَأً مِنْ كِتَابِي، أَوْ خَطَأً مِنْ سُفْيَانَ، فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ سُفْيَانَ فَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَحْفَظُ لِحَدِيثِ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ مِنْ سُفْيَانَ، وَمَعَ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ حَدِيثُ اللَّيْثِ وَغَيْرُهُ، وَأَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ يُحَدُّ الْحَدِيثَ تَحْدِيدًا، يُخْبِرُ فِيهِ حَيَاةَ الَّذِي دَبَّرَهُ، وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ مَعَ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ وَغَيْرِهِ أَحْفَظُ لِحَدِيثِ عَمْرٍو مَعَ سُفْيَانَ وَحْدَهُ، وَقَدْ يُسْتَدَلُّ عَلَى حِفْظِ الْحَدِيثِ مِنْ خَطَئِهِ بِأَقَلَّ مِمَّا وَجَدْتُ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ وَاللَّيْثِ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو، وَغَيْرُ حَمَّادٍ يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ عَمْرٍو كَمَا رَوَاهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ مِمَّنْ لَقِيَ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ قَدِيمًا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُدْخِلُ فِي حَدِيثهِ: مَاتَ، وَعَجِبَ بَعْضُهُمْ حِينَ أَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنِّي وَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي: مَاتَ، قَالَ: وَلَعَلَّ هَذَا خَطَأٌ عَنْهُ أَوْ زَلَّةُ مِنْهُ حَفِظْتُهَا عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar and from Abu al-Zubayr, who both heard Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ﵄ say:
entries.matn_en: A man of ours freed a slave of his by tadbir, and he had no property other than him. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Who will buy him from me?” Nu'aym al-Nahham bought him. 'Amr said: I heard Jabir say: “a Coptic slave who died the year before, during the governorship of Ibn al-Zubayr.” And Abu al-Zubayr added: “He was called Ya'qub.” Al-Shafi'i ﵁ said: This is how I heard it from him for most of my life; then I found in my book: “A man of ours freed a slave of his by tadbir, and he died.” Either that is an error in my book, or an error of Sufyan. If it is from Sufyan, then Ibn Jurayj is a better preserver of Abu al-Zubayr's hadith than Sufyan, and with Ibn Jurayj is the hadith of al-Layth and others. Abu al-Zubayr delimits the hadith precisely, reporting in it the lifespan of the one who was made mudabbar [the slave]. And Hammad b. Zayd, together with Hammad b. Salama and others, is a better preserver of 'Amr's hadith than Sufyan alone. One may judge the soundness of a hadith's preservation from its error by less than what I found in the hadith of Ibn Jurayj and al-Layth from Abu al-Zubayr, and in the hadith of Hammad from 'Amr; and others besides Hammad narrate it from 'Amr as Hammad b. Zayd narrated it. More than one person who met Sufyan b. 'Uyayna early on has informed me that he did not include “he died” in his hadith, and some of them were astonished when I told him that I had found “he died” in my book. He said: Perhaps this is an error of his, or a slip of his that I memorized from him.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Insolvency

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَفْلَسَ فَأَدْرَكَ الرَّجُلُ مَالَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Abu Bakr b. Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Hazm, from 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, from Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Any man who becomes insolvent, and a man finds his own property with him exactly as it was, is more entitled to it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مَالَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Wahhab b. 'Abd al-Majid al-Thaqafi informed us that he heard Yahya b. Sa'id say: Abu Bakr b. Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Hazm informed me that 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz narrated to him that Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham narrated to him that he heard Abu Hurayra ﵁ say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever finds his own property exactly as it was with a man who has become insolvent is more entitled to it than anyone else.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَمْرِو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ خَلْدَةَ الزُّرَقِيِّ، وَكَانَ، قَاضِي الْمَدِينَةِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جِئْنَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ فِي صَاحِبٍ لَنَا قَدْ أَفْلَسَ فَقَالَ: هَذَا الَّذِي قَضَى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ مَاتَ أَوْ أَفْلَسَ فَصَاحِبُ الْمَتَاعِ أَحَقُّ بِمَتَاعِهِ إِذَا وَجَدَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, who said: The son of 'Amr b. Rafi' narrated to me, from Ibn Khaldat al-Zuraqi — who was the judge of Medina — that he said:
entries.matn_en: We came to Abu Hurayra about a companion of ours who had become insolvent, and he said: “This is the case in which the Messenger of God ﷺ ruled: ‘Any man who dies or becomes insolvent, the owner of the goods is more entitled to his goods if he finds them exactly as they were.’”

sections.title_en: From the Book of Claims and Evidence

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ، تَدَاعَيَا دَابَّةً فَأَقَامَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا الْبَيِّنَةَ أَنَّهَا دَابَّتَهُ نَتَجَهَا، فَقَضَى بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلَّذِي هِيَ فِي يَدَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Yahya informed us, from Ishaq b. Abi Farwa, from 'Umar b. al-Hakam, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: two men disputed over an animal, and each of them produced proof that it was his animal which he had bred; and the Messenger of God ﷺ ruled that it belonged to the one in whose possession it was.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَشْتَرِطُ عَلَى الَّذِي يُكْرِيهِ الْأَرْضَ أَنْ لَا يُعِرْهَا، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدَعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْكِرَاءَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Yahya informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: he used to stipulate to the one to whom he rented out land that he must not lend it out [to others]; and that was before 'Abd Allah gave up renting [land].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ شَكَّ فِي ابْنٍ لَهُ فَدَعَا لَهُ الْقَافَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Ulayya informed us, from Humayd, from Anas, that
entries.matn_en: he had doubts about a son of his and so called the physiognomists (qafa) for him.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَاطِبٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ تَدَاعَيَا وَلَدًا فَدَعَا لَهُ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه الْقَافَةَ فَقَالُوا: قَدِ اشْتَرَكَا فِيهِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: «وَالِ أَيَّهُمَا شِئْتَ» أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ ⦗ص: 331⦘ . أَخْبَرَنَا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ مَازِنٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ
entries.isnad_en: Anas b. 'Iyad informed us, from Hisham, from his father, from Yahya b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hatib, that
entries.matn_en: two men both claimed a child, and 'Umar ﵁ called the physiognomists for him, and they said: “They both share in him.” 'Umar ﵁ said: “Take as your guardian whichever of them you wish.” Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sulayman b. Yasar, from 'Umar ﵁, with similar meaning [p. 331]. Mutarrif b. Mazin informed us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁, with similar meaning.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي شَهَادَةِ النِّسَاءِ عَلَى الشَّيْءِ مِنْ أَمْرِ النِّسَاءِ: «لَا يَجُوزُ فِيهِ أَقَلُّ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Muslim and Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', that
entries.matn_en: he said regarding the testimony of women on a matter that concerns women's affairs: “Fewer than four is not permissible in it.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of the Prophet’s Commands, Minor Walāʾ, Medical Error, etc.
sections.title_ar: وَمِنْ كِتَابِ صِفَةِ أَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْوَلَاءِ الصَّغِيرِ وَخَطَأِ الطَّبِيبِ وَغَيْرِهِ

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يُمْسِكَنَّ النَّاسُ عَلَيَّ شَيْئًا، فَإِنِّي لَا أُحِلُّ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ، وَلَا أُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, with his chain of transmission, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Let people not hold anything against me [as an authority], for I do not make lawful for them anything except what God has made lawful for them, and I do not forbid them anything except what God has forbidden them.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ طَارِقَ بْنَ الْمُرَقَّعِ، أَعْتَقَ أَهْلَ أَبْيَاتٍ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ سَوَائِبَ فَانْقَلَعُوا عَنْ بَضْعَةَ عَشَرَ أَلْفًا، فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَدْفَعَ إِلَى طَارِقٍ أَوْ وَرَثَةِ طَارِقٍ أَنَا شَكَكْتُ فِي الْحَدِيثِ هَكَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Muslim and Sa'id ibn Salim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', that
entries.matn_en: Tariq b. al-Muraqqi' freed the members of several households from Yemen as sa'iba (freed without any wala' tie), and they departed [leaving an estate of] more than ten thousand. That was mentioned to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁, and he ordered me to hand [it] over to Tariq or to the heirs of Tariq — I am uncertain about the hadith in this way.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Sharecropping and Land Rental

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ السِّنِينَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from Humayd b. Qays, from Sulayman b. 'Atiq, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the sale of [crops for] years (bay' al-sinin). Sufyan informed us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «نَهَيْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ بَيْعِ النَّخْلِ، مُعَاوَمَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, that he heard Jabir b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: “I forbade Ibn al-Zubayr from selling date palms on a multi-year basis (mu'awama).”

sections.title_en: From the Book of the Theft Penalty and Numerous Other Chapters
sections.title_ar: وَمِنْ كِتَابِ الْقَطْعِ فِي السَّرِقَةِ، وَأَبْوَابٍ كَثِيرَةٍ

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْقَطْعُ فِي رُبُعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Amra, from 'A'isha ﵂, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The [hand] is cut for a quarter of a dinar or more.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ سَارِقًا فِي مِجَنٍّ قِيمَتُهُ ثَلَاثَةُ دَرَاهِمٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ had a thief's hand cut for [stealing] a shield worth three dirhams.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سَارِقًا، سَرَقَ أُتْرُجَّةً فِي عَهْدِ عُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنه فَأَمَرَ بِهَا عُثْمَانُ فَقُوِّمَتْ ثَلَاثَةَ دَرَاهِمٍ مِنْ صَرْفِ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ دِرْهَمًا بِدِينَارٍ فَقَطَعَ يَدَهُ قَالَ مَالِكٌ رضي الله عنه: «وَهِيَ الْأُتْرُجَّةُ الَّتِي يَأْكُلُهَا النَّاسُ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr b. Hazm, from his father, from 'Amra bint 'Abd al-Rahman, that
entries.matn_en: a thief stole a citron (utrujja) in the time of 'Uthman ﵁. 'Uthman ordered it assessed, and it was valued at three dirhams, at the exchange rate of twelve dirhams to the dinar, and he had his hand cut. Malik ﵁ said: “It is the citron that people eat.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ قَتَادَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: يَسْأَلُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الْقَطْعِ، فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ: «حَضَرْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ رضي الله عنه قَطَعَ سَارِقًا فِي شَيْءٍ مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّهُ لِي بِثَلَاثَةِ دَرَاهِمٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Humayd al-Tawil, that he heard Qatada
entries.matn_en: ask Anas b. Malik about the cutting [of the thief's hand], and Anas said: “I was present when Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁ had a thief's hand cut for something I would not be pleased to own for three dirhams.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْقَطْعُ فِي رُبُعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا»
entries.isnad_en: More than one person informed us, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from 'Ali ﵁, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The hand is cut for a quarter of a dinar or more.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ رضي الله عنه أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ» أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Muhammad b. Yahya b. Habban, that Rafi' b. Khadij ﵁ informed him that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: “There is no cutting for fruit (thamar) or for palm-pith (kathar).” Sufyan informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Muhammad b. Yahya b. Habban, from his uncle Wasi' b. Habban, from Rafi' b. Khadij, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ، قِيلَ لَهُ: مَنْ لَمْ يُهَاجِرْ هَلَكَ، فَقَدِمَ صَفْوَانُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَنَامَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مُتَوَسِّدًا رِدَاءَهُ، فَجَاءَ سَارِقٌ فَأَخَذَ رِدَاءَهُ مِنْ تَحْتِ رَأْسِهِ، فَأَخَذَ صَفْوَانُ السَّارِقَ فَجَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ، فَقَالَ صَفْوَانُ: إِنِّي لَمْ أُرِدْ هَذَا، هُوَ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فَهَلَّا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنِي بِهِ» أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Safwan b. 'Abd Allah, that
entries.matn_en: it was said to Safwan b. Umayya: “Whoever does not emigrate is ruined.” So Safwan came to Medina and slept in the mosque using his cloak as a pillow. A thief came and took his cloak from under his head. Safwan seized the thief and brought him to the Prophet ﷺ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ ordered that his hand be cut. Safwan said: “I did not intend this; it is charity for him.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Why not before you brought him to me?” Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr, from Tawus, from the Prophet ﷺ, like the hadith of Malik ﵁.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ مُعَلَّقٍ، فَإِذَا آوَاهُ الْجَرِينُ فَفِيهِ الْقَطْعُ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Abi Husayn, from 'Amr b. Shu'ayb, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no cutting for fruit still hanging [on the tree]; but once the threshing floor has sheltered it, there is cutting for it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضي الله عنها إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَمَعَهَا مَوْلَاتَانِ وَغُلَامٌ لِابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، فَبَعَثَتْ مَعَ الْمَوْلَاتَيْنِ بِبُرْدِ مَرَاجِلَ قَدْ خِيطَ عَلَيْهِ خِرْقَةٌ خَضْرَاءُ، قَالَتْ: فَأَخَذَ الْغُلَامُ الْبُرْدَ فَفَتَقَ عَنْهُ فَاسْتَخْرَجَهُ وَجَعَلَ مَكَانَهُ لِبْدًا وَفَرْوَةً وَخَاطَ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَتِ الْمَوْلَاتَانِ الْمَدِينَةَ دَفَعَتَا ذَلِكَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، فَلَمَّا فَتَقُوا عَنْهُ وَجَدُوا فِيهِ اللِّبْدَ وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا فِيهِ الْبُرْدَ، فَكَلَّمُوا الْمَوْلَاتَيْنِ فَكَلَّمَتَا عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَطَعَتْ يَدَهُ ⦗ص: 336⦘ ، وَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضي الله عنها: «الْقَطْعُ فِي رُبُعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, from 'Amra bint 'Abd al-Rahman, that she said:
entries.matn_en: 'A'isha ﵂ set out for Mecca accompanied by two freedwomen and a slave boy belonging to the son of 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr al-Siddiq. She sent with the two freedwomen a striped Yemeni cloth (burd marajil) with a piece of green cloth sewn onto it. She said: The boy took the cloth, unpicked it, took it out, put in its place a piece of felt and a sheepskin, and sewed it up. When the two freedwomen reached Medina they handed it over to its owners; when they unpicked it they found the felt in it and did not find the cloth. They spoke to the two freedwomen, who spoke to 'A'isha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and she had his hand cut [p. 336]. 'A'isha ﵂ said: “The hand is cut for a quarter of a dinar or more.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ أَقْطَعَ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ قَدِمَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَشَكَى إِلَيْهِ أَنَّ عَامِلَ الْيَمَنِ ظَلَمَهُ وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَيَقُولُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه: «وَأَبِيكَ مَا لَيْلُكَ بِلَيْلِ سَارِقٍ» إِنَّهُمُ افْتَقَدُوا حُلِيًّا لِأَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ امْرَأَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَطُوفُ مَعَهُمْ وَيَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِمَنْ بَيَّتَ أَهْلَ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ الصَّالِحِ، فَوَجَدُوا الْحُلِيَّ عِنْدَ صَائِغٍ وَأَنَّ الْأَقْطَعَ جَاءَهُ بِهِ فَاعْتَرَفَ الْأَقْطَعُ، أَوْ شُهِدَ عَلَيْهِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ الْيُسْرَى، وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه: «وَاللَّهِ لَدُعَاؤُهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَشَدُّ عِنْدِي مِنْ سَرِقَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: a man from Yemen, with his hand and foot cut off, came to Abu Bakr and complained to him that the governor of Yemen had wronged him. He used to pray during the night, and Abu Bakr ﵁ would say: “By your father, your night is not the night of a thief.” Then it happened that they missed some jewelry belonging to Asma' bint 'Umays, wife of Abu Bakr, and the man went around with them saying: “O God, [be] against whoever burgled the people of this righteous house!” They found the jewelry with a goldsmith, and the one-handed man was the one who had brought it to him. The one-handed man confessed — or testimony was given against him — and Abu Bakr ﵁ ordered his left hand cut. Abu Bakr ﵁ said: “By God, his supplication against himself is more serious in my eyes than his theft.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، مَوْلَى التَّوْأَمَةِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قُطَّاعِ الطَّرِيقِ: إِذَا قَتَلُوا وَأَخَذُوا الْمَالَ قُتِلُوا وَصُلِّبُوا، وَإِذَا قَتَلُوا وَلَمْ يَأْخُذُوا الْمَالَ قُتِلُوا وَلَمْ يُصَلَّبُوا، وَإِذَا أَخَذُوا الْمَالَ وَلَمْ يَقْتُلُوا قُطِعَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ، وَإِذَا أَخَافُوا السَّبِيلَ وَلَمْ يَأْخُذُوا مَالًا نُفُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim informed us, from Salih, freedman of al-Taw'ama, from Ibn 'Abbas, regarding highway robbers:
entries.matn_en: When they kill and take property, they are killed and crucified; when they kill and do not take property, they are killed and not crucified; when they take property and do not kill, their hands and feet are cut off on opposite sides; and when they terrorize the road and take no property, they are banished from the land.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «الرَّجْمُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِذَا أُحْصِنَ إِذَا قَامَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةُ أَوْ كَانَ الْحَبَلُ أَوِ الِاعْتِرَافُ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah, from Ibn 'Abbas, that he said: I heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ say:
entries.matn_en: “Stoning is a truth in the Book of God for whoever commits adultery among men and women, if he is muhsan (previously married), when proof has been established against him, or there is pregnancy, or confession.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ وَهُوَ بِالشَّامِ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا، فَبَعَثَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَبَا وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيَّ إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ ⦗ص: 337⦘ يَسْأَلُهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَتَاهَا وَعِنْدَهَا نِسْوَةٌ فَذَكَرَ لَهَا الَّذِي قَالَ زَوْجُهَا لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ وَأَخْبَرَهَا أَنَّهُ لَا تُؤْخَذُ بِقَوْلِهِ، وَجَعَلَ يُلَقِّنُهَا أَشْبَاهَ ذَلِكَ لِتَنْزِعَ فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَنْزِعَ وَثَبَتَتْ عَلَى الِاعْتِرَافِ، فَأَمَرَ بِهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَرُجِمَتْ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sulayman b. Yasar, from Abu Waqid al-Laythi, that
entries.matn_en: a man came to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁, while he was in Syria, and told him that he had found a man with his wife. 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ sent Abu Waqid al-Laythi to the wife [p. 337] to ask her about it. He came to her while women were with her, and told her what her husband had said to 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and informed her that she would not be seized on the strength of his statement; and he began prompting her with statements of this kind so that she would retract. But she refused to retract and held fast to her confession, so 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ ordered that she be stoned, and she was stoned.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، دَعَا نَفَرًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَعْنِي إِلَى الْوَلِيمَةِ، فَأَتَاهُ فِيهِمْ أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ. وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ فَبَارَكَ وَانْصَرَفَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Wahhab al-Thaqafi informed us, from Ayyub, from Muhammad b. Sirin, that
entries.matn_en: his father invited a group of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ, meaning to a wedding banquet (walima), and Ubayy b. Ka'b came among them. And I think he said: he blessed [the host] and left.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: دَعَا أَبِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ فَأَتَاهُ فَجَلَسَ، وَوُضِعَ الطَّعَامُ فَمَدَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ: خُذُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَقَبَضَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ: «إِنِّي صَائِمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us that he heard 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Yazid say:
entries.matn_en: My father invited 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, and he came and sat. The food was set out, and 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar stretched out his hand and said: “Take, in the name of God.” Then 'Abd Allah drew back his hand and said: “I am fasting.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَجَمَاعَةً مَعَهُ فَأَكَلُوا عِنْدَهُ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ فِي غَيْرِ وَلِيمَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from Ishaq b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Talha, from Anas b. Malik ﵁, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ came to Abu Talha with a group, and they ate with him, and that was not at a wedding banquet.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Baḥīra and Sāʾiba

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ جَارِيَةً تُعْتِقُهَا فَقَالَ أَهْلُهَا: نَبِيعُكِهَا عَلَى أَنَّ وَلَاءَهَا لَنَا، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «لَا يَمْنَعُكِ ذَلِكَ، إِنَّمَا الْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, from 'A'isha ﵂, that
entries.matn_en: she wished to buy a slave girl in order to free her, and the girl's owners said: “We will sell her to you on condition that her wala' (patronage tie) is ours.” She mentioned that to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he said: “Let that not prevent you; wala' belongs only to the one who frees.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ، جَاءَتْ تَسْتَعِينُ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: إِنْ أَحَبَّ أَهْلُكِ أَنْ أَصُبَّ لَهُمْ ثَمَنَكِ صَبَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأُعْتِقَكِ فَعَلْتُ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ بَرِيرَةُ لِأَهْلِهَا فَقَالُوا: لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ وَلَاؤُكِ لَنَا. قَالَ مَالِكٌ: قَالَ يَحْيَى: فَزَعَمَتْ عَمْرَةُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «لَا يَمْنَعُكِ ذَلِكَ، فَاشْتَرِيهَا فَأَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us: Yahya b. Sa'id narrated to me, from 'Amra bint 'Abd al-Rahman, that
entries.matn_en: Barira came seeking 'A'isha's help, and 'A'isha said: “If your owners would like me to pour out your price for them in a single payment and free you, I will do so.” Barira mentioned that to her owners and they said: “No, unless your wala' is ours.” Malik said: Yahya said: 'Amra claimed that 'A'isha mentioned that to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he said: “Let that not prevent you; buy her and free her, for wala' belongs only to the one who frees.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، وَابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik and Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the sale of wala' and its gifting.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْوَلَاءُ لُحْمَةٌ كَلُحْمَةِ النَّسَبِ، لَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Hasan informed us, from Ya'qub b. Ibrahim, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Wala' is a bond like the bond of lineage; it is not sold and not given away.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْأَيْلِيِّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يُطِيعَ اللَّهَ فَلْيُطِعْهُ، وَمَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَعْصِيَ اللَّهَ فَلَا يَعْصِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Talha b. 'Abd al-Malik al-Ayli, from al-Qasim, from 'A'isha, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever vows to obey God, let him obey Him; and whoever vows to disobey God, let him not disobey Him.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، وَعَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ وَلَا فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ ابْنُ آدَمَ» وَكَانَ الثَّقَفِيُّ سَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna and 'Abd al-Wahhab b. 'Abd al-Majid informed us, from Ayyub b. Abi Tamima al-Sakhtiyani, from Abu Qilaba, from Abu al-Muhallab, from 'Imran b. Husayn ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no vow in disobedience to God, nor in what the son of Adam does not own.” And al-Thaqafi had narrated the hadith at length and then mentioned this.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِأَبِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ: «مَالَهُ؟» فَقَالُوا: نَذَرَ أَنْ لَا يَسْتَظِلَّ وَلَا يَقْعُدَ وَلَا يُكَلِّمَ أَحَدًا وَيَصُومَ، فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَسْتَظِلَّ وَيَقْعُدَ وَأَنْ يُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ وَيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ، وَلَمْ يَأْمُرْهُ بِكَفَّارَةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr, from Tawus, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ passed by Abu Isra'il as he was standing in the sun and said: “What is the matter with him?” They said: “He vowed not to take shade, not to sit, not to speak to anyone, and to fast.” The Prophet ﷺ ordered him to take shade, to sit, to speak to people, and to complete his fast, and he did not order him [to pay] any expiation.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ مَالًا لَمُ أُصِبْ مِثْلَهُ قَطُّ، وَقَدْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَتَقَرَّبَ بِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «احْبِسْ أَصْلَهُ، وَسَبِّلْ ثَمَرَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar ﵁ came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of God, I have acquired wealth the like of which I have never acquired, and I wish to draw near to God with it.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Hold its principal, and let its fruit flow [as charity] in the way of God.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of Hunting and Slaughter

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ الْفُلْجَةِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ، أَوِ ابْنِ سَعْدٍ الْفُلْجَةِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا نَصَارَى الْعَرَبِ بِأَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، وَمَا تَحِلُّ لَنَا ذَبَائِحُهُمْ، وَمَا أَنَا بِتَارِكِهِمْ حَتَّى يُسْلِمُوا أَوْ أَضْرِبَ أَعْنَاقَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Abi Yahya informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Dinar, from Sa'd al-Fuljah, freedman of 'Umar — or Ibn Sa'd al-Fuljah — that 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ said:
entries.matn_en: “The Christians of the Arabs are not People of the Book, and their slaughtered animals are not lawful for us; and I will not leave them alone until they accept Islam or I strike off their necks.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ السَّلْمَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تَأْكُلُوا ذَبَائِحَ نَصَارَى بَنِي تَغْلِبَ؛ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَتَمَسَّكُوا مِنْ دِينِهِمْ إِلَّا بِشُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Thaqafi informed us, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, from 'Abida al-Salmani, from 'Ali ﵁, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not eat the slaughtered animals of the Christians of the Banu Taghlib, for they held fast to nothing of their religion except drinking wine.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَاتِمٌ، وَالدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، أَوْ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «النُّونُ وَالْجَرَادُ ذَكِيٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Hatim and al-Darawardi — or one of them — informed us, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “Fish and locusts are lawfully slaughtered [as they are].”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " أُحِلَّتْ لَنَا مَيْتَتَانِ وَدَمَانِ، الْمَيْتَتَانِ: الْحُوتُ وَالْجَرَادِ، وَالدَّمَانِ، أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ: الْكَبِدُ وَالطِّحَالُ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Zayd b. Aslam informed us, from his father, from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Two dead animals and two [kinds of] blood have been made lawful for us. The two dead animals are fish and locusts; and the two bloods — I think he said — are the liver and the spleen.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ ⦗ص: 341⦘ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا لَاقُو الْعَدُوِّ غَدًا، وَلَيْسَتْ مَعَنَا مُدًى، أَنُذَكِّي بِاللِّيطِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا أَنْهَرَ الدَّمَ وَذُكِرَ عَلَيْهِ اسْمُ اللَّهَ فَكُلُوا، إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ سِنٍّ أَوْ ظُفُرٍ؛ فَإِنَّ السِّنَّ عَظْمٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ، وَالظُّفُرَ مُدَى الْحَبَشِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Sa'id ibn Masruq, from his father, from 'Abaya b. [p. 341] Rifa'a, from Rafi' b. Khadij ﵁, who said:
entries.matn_en: We said: “O Messenger of God, we will meet the enemy tomorrow and we have no knives; may we slaughter with a reed (lit)?” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whatever makes the blood flow and has God's name mentioned over it, eat — except for a tooth or a nail; for the tooth is a bone of the human, and the nail is the knife of the Abyssinians.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الضَّبُعِ، أَصَيْدٌ هِيَ؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، قُلْتُ: أَتُؤْكَلُ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قُلْتُ: أَسَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ " سَمِعْتُ الرَّبِيعَ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّافِعِيَّ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ: «لَوْلَا مَالِكٌ وَسُفْيَانُ لَذَهَبَ عِلْمُ الْحِجَازِ» سَمِعْتُ الرَّبِيعَ، يَقُولُ: «مَاتَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رضي الله عنه سَنَةَ أَرْبَعٍ وَمِائَتَيْنِ فِي آخِرِ يَوْمٍ مِنْ رَجَبٍ»، وَسُئِلَ عَنْ سِنِّهِ فَقَالَ: «نَيِّفٌ وَخَمْسُونَ سَنَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Muslim, 'Abd al-Majid and 'Abd Allah b. al-Harith informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr, from Ibn Abi 'Ammar, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Jabir b. 'Abd Allah about the hyena: is it game? He said: “Yes.” I said: “Is it eaten?” He said: “Yes.” I said: “Did you hear that from the Messenger of God ﷺ?” He said: “Yes.” I heard al-Rabi' say: I heard al-Shafi'i ﵁ say: “Were it not for Malik and Sufyan, the knowledge of the Hijaz would have gone.” I heard al-Rabi' say: “Al-Shafi'i ﵁ died in the year 204, on the last day of Rajab.” And [apparently al-Rabi'] was asked about his age, and said: “A little over fifty years.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ أُعْمِرَ شَيْئًا فَهُوَ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', from Jabir, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever is given something as a lifetime gift ('umra), it is his.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ حُجْرٍ الْمَدَرِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الْعُمْرَى لِلْوَارِثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Tawus, from Hujr al-Madari, from Zayd b. Thabit, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The 'umra belongs to the heir.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، وَابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَجَاءَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ لَهُ: إِنِّي أَعْطَيْتُ بَعْضَ بَنِيَّ نَاقَةً حَيَاتَهُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو فِي الْحَدِيثِ: وَإِنَّهَا تَنَاتَجَتْ. وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ: وَإِنَّهَا ⦗ص: 342⦘ أَضَنَّتْ وَاضْطَرَبَتْ، فَقَالَ: هِيَ لَهُ حَيَاتَهُ وَمَوْتَهُ، قَالَ: فَإِنِّي تَصَدَّقْتُ بِهَا عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ:؟ «فَذَلِكَ أَبْعَدُ لَكَ مِنْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar and Ibn Abi Najih, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar when a Bedouin came to him and said: “I gave one of my sons a she-camel for his lifetime.” 'Amr said in the hadith: “and she has produced offspring.” And Ibn Abi Najih said in his hadith: “and she [p. 342] has become precious and unsettled (the wording is uncertain).” He said: “She is his, in his life and at his death.” He said: “But I gave her to him as charity.” He said: “Then that puts you even further from her.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «عَقْلُ الْعَبْدِ فِي ثَمَنِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyib, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “The blood-money for [injury to] a slave is according to his price.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «عَقْلُ الْعَبْدِ فِي ثَمَنِهِ كَجِرَاحِ الْحُرِّ فِي دِيَتِهِ». وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: وَكَانَ رِجَالٌ سِوَاهُ يَقُولُونَ: يُقَوَّمُ سِلْعَةً
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Hassan informed us, from al-Layth b. Sa'd, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “The blood-money for [injury to] a slave is according to his price, like the wounds of a free man according to his diya.” And Ibn Shihab said: Other men used to say: He is valued as a commodity.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمِّي، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنِّي لَأَسْمَعُ الْحَدِيثَ فَأَسْتَحْسِنُهُ فَمَا يَمْنَعُنِي مِنْ ذِكْرِهِ إِلَّا كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَسْمَعَهُ مِنِّي سَامِعٌ فَيَقْتَدِي بِهِ. أَسْمَعُهُ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ لَا أَثِقُ بِهِ قَدْ حَدَّثَهُ عَمَّنْ أَثِقُ بِهِ، وَأَسْمَعُهُ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ أَثِقُ بِهِ قَدْ حَدَّثَهُ عَمَّنْ لَا أَثِقُ بِهِ». وَقَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: «لَا يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا الثِّقَاتُ»
entries.isnad_en: My uncle Muhammad b. 'Ali informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “I hear a hadith and find it excellent, and nothing prevents me from mentioning it except my dislike that a listener hear it from me and follow it. I hear it from a man I do not trust, who narrated it from someone I trust; and I hear it from a man I trust, who narrated it from someone I do not trust.” And Sa'd b. Ibrahim said: “None should narrate from the Prophet ﷺ except the trustworthy.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ ابْنًا لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ، فَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِيهَا شَيْئًا، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: «إِنَّا لَنُعْظِمُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مِثْلُكَ ابْنَ إِمَامَيْ هُدًى وَتُسْأَلُ عَنْ أَمْرٍ لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ فِيهِ عِلْمٌ»، فَقَالَ: «أَعْظَمُ وَاللَّهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ مَنْ عَرَفَ اللَّهَ وَعِنْدَ مَنْ عَقِلَ عَنِ اللَّهِ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ أَوْ أَخْبَرَ عَنْ غَيْرِ ثِقَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked a son of 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar about a question, and he said nothing about it. It was said to him: “We find it grave that someone like you, the son of two imams of guidance, should be asked about a matter of which you have no knowledge.” He said: “Graver, by God, than that, in the sight of God, and in the sight of those who know God and those who understand from God, is for me to say what I have no knowledge of, or to report from someone other than a trustworthy person.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of Blood Money and Retaliation

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ الْحُصَيْنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا غَطَفَانَ بْنَ طَرِيفٍ الْمُرِّيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ أَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَسْأَلُهُ مَا فِي الضِّرْسِ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: فِيهِ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ. فَرَدَّنِي مَرْوَانُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ: أَفَنَجْعَلُ مُقَدَّمَ الْفَمِ مِثْلَ الْأَضْرَاسِ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: لَوْلَا أَنَّكَ لَا تَعْتَبِرُ ذَلِكَ إِلَّا بِالْأَصَابِعِ، عَقْلُهُمَا سَوَاءٌ قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رضي الله عنه: فَهَذَا مِمَّا يَدُلُّكُ عَلَى أَنَّ الشَّفَتَيْنِ عَقْلُهُمَا سَوَاءٌ. وَقَدْ جَاءَ فِي الشَّفَتَيْنِ سِوَى هَذَا آثَارٌ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Hasan informed us: Malik informed us: Dawud b. al-Husayn narrated to us that Abu Ghatafan b. Tarif al-Murri informed him that
entries.matn_en: Marwan b. al-Hakam sent him to Ibn 'Abbas to ask him what is [owed] for a molar. Ibn 'Abbas said: “Five camels.” Marwan sent me back to Ibn 'Abbas and said: “Do we make the front of the mouth like the molars?” Ibn 'Abbas said: “Were it not that you consider that only by the fingers [which are equal in diya though they differ in use], the blood-money for the two is equal.” Al-Shafi'i ﵁ said: This is among the things that indicate that the blood-money for the two lips is equal. And besides this, other reports have come concerning the lips.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْكَعْبِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ قُتِلَ لَهُ قَتِيلٌ فَأَهْلُهُ بَيْنَ خِيَرَتَيْنِ، إِنْ أَحَبُّوا فَلَهُمُ الْعَقْلُ، وَإِنْ أَحَبُّوا فَلَهُمُ الْقَوَدُ» أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ، أَوْ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Isma'il b. Abi Fudayk informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Shurayh al-Ka'bi, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever has a relative killed, his family has two choices: if they wish, they have the blood-money, and if they wish, they have retaliation (qawad).” The trustworthy one informed us, from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Salama, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same or with the same meaning.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْبَيْلَمَانِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَتَلَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فَرُفِعَ ⦗ص: 344⦘ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «أَنَا أَحَقُّ مَنْ أَوْفَى بِذِمَّتِهِ». ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَقُتِلَ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Hasan informed us: Ibrahim b. Muhammad informed us, from Muhammad b. al-Munkadir, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Baylamani, that
entries.matn_en: a man of the Muslims killed a man of the dhimma (protected non-Muslims), and the matter was brought [p. 344] before the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: “I am the most deserving of those who fulfill his covenant.” Then he ordered that [the killer] be put to death, and he was killed.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعٍ الْأَسَدِيُّ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجَنُوبِ الْأَسَدِيِّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أُتِيَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه بِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَتَلَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ، قَالَ: فَقَامَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةُ فَأَمَرَ بِقَتْلِهِ، فَجَاءَ أَخُوهُ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَدْ عَفَوْتُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: «فَلَعَلَّهُمْ هَدَّدُوكَ أَوْ فَرَّقُوكَ أَوْ فَزَّعُوكَ»، قَالَ: لَا، وَلَكِنْ قَتْلُهُ لَا يَرُدُّ عَلَيَّ أَخِي، وَعَوَّضُونِي فَرَضِيتُ، قَالَ: أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ، «مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ذِمَّتُنَا فَدَمُهُ كَدَمِنَا، وَدِيَتُهُ كَدِيَتِنَا»
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Hasan informed us: Qays b. al-Rabi' al-Asadi narrated to us, from Aban b. Taghlib, from al-Hasan b. Maymun, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Abd Allah, freedman of the Banu Hashim, from Abu al-Janub al-Asadi, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali b. Abi Talib ﵁ was brought a man of the Muslims who had killed a man of the dhimma. He said: Proof was established against him, so ['Ali] ordered his execution. Then [the victim's] brother came and said: “I have pardoned him.” He said: “Perhaps they threatened you, or intimidated you, or frightened you.” He said: “No, but killing him will not bring back my brother, and they compensated me and I was satisfied.” He said: “You know best. Whoever has our covenant, his blood is like our blood, and his blood-money is like our blood-money.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ شَاسٍ الْجُذَامِيَّ، قَتَلَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَنْبَاطِ الشَّامِ فَرُفِعَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه فَأَمَرَ بِقَتْلِهِ، فَكَلَّمَهُ الزُّبَيْرُ وَنَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَهَوْهُ عَنْ قَتْلِهِ، قَالَ: فَجَعَلَ دِيَتَهُ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Hasan informed us: Muhammad b. Yazid informed us: Sufyan b. Husayn informed us, from al-Zuhri, that
entries.matn_en: Ibn Shas al-Judhami killed a man of the Nabataeans of Syria, and the case was brought to 'Uthman b. 'Affan ﵁, who ordered his execution. Then al-Zubayr and some of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ spoke to him and dissuaded him from killing him. He said: So he set the blood-money at one thousand dinars.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «دِيَةُ كُلِّ مُعَاهَدٍ فِي عَهْدِهِ أَلْفُ دِينَارٍ»
entries.isnad_en: And through the same chain, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The blood-money of every covenant-holder (mu'ahad) under his covenant is one thousand dinars.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
entries.matn_ar: وَطَاوُسٍ، وَمُجَاهِدٍ، وَالْحَسَنِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ: «لَا يُقْتَلُ مُسْلِمٌ بِكَافِرٍ» فَقَالَ: هَذَا مُرْسَلٌ، قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim informed us, from Ibn Husayn, from 'Ata', Tawus, Mujahid and al-Hasan, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ said in his sermon in the year of the Conquest: “A Muslim is not killed for an unbeliever.” He [the interlocutor] said: “This is a mursal report.” I said: “Yes.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ صَدَقَةَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ نَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ دِيَةِ الْمُعَاهِدِ، فَقَالَ: «قَضَى فِيهِ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه بِأَرْبَعَةِ آلَافٍ»، قَالَ: فَقُلْنَا: فَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ؟ قَالَ: فَحَصَبَنَا قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: هُمُ الَّذِينَ سَأَلُوهُ آخِرًا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna informed us, from Sadaqa b. Yasar, who said:
entries.matn_en: We sent to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib to ask him about the blood-money of a covenant-holder, and he said: “'Uthman b. 'Affan ﵁ ruled it at four thousand.” He said: We said: “And what of those before him?” He said: and he pelted us with pebbles. Al-Shafi'i said: They are the ones who asked him afterward.

entries.label: Report
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رضي الله عنه: فَإِنْ قَالَ قَائِلٌ: مَا الْخَبَرُ بِأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى بِالْجَنِينِ عَلَى الْعَاقِلَةِ؟ قِيلَ: أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، قَالَ الرَّبِيعُ: وَهُوَ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ⦗ص: 345⦘ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ قُتِلَ فِي عِمِّيَّةٍ فِي رِمِّيَّا تَكُونُ بَيْنَهُمْ بِحِجَارَةٍ أَوْ جَلْدٍ بِالسَّوْطِ أَوْ ضَرْبٍ بِعَصًا فَهُوَ خَطَأٌ، عَقْلُهُ عَقْلُ الْخَطَإِ، وَمَنْ قُتِلَ عَمْدًا فَهُوَ قَوَدُ يَدِهِ، فَمَنْ حَالَ دُونَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَغَضَبُهِ، لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلَا عَدْلٌ»
entries.matn_en: Al-Shafi'i ﵁ said: If someone asks: What is the report that the Prophet ﷺ ruled that the fetus [be paid for] by the 'aqila (the paternal kin responsible for blood-money)? It is said: The trustworthy one informed us — al-Rabi' said: he is Yahya b. Hassan — from al-Layth b. Sa'd [p. 345], from Ibn Shihab, from Ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra ﵁. Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Tawus, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “Whoever is killed in a blind melee ('immiyya) — in stone-throwing among them, or whipping with a whip, or striking with a stick — it is an error, and its blood-money is the blood-money of error. And whoever is killed intentionally, it is retaliation by his hand. Whoever stands in its way, on him is the curse of God and His wrath; no repentance and no ransom will be accepted from him.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَلَا إِنَّ فِي قَتْلِ الْعَمْدِ الْخَطَإِ بِالسَّوْطِ وَالْعَصَا مِائَةً مِنَ الْإِبِلِ مُغَلَّظَةً، مِنْهَا أَرْبَعُونَ خَلِفَةً فِي بُطُونِهَا أَوْلَادُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Ulayya informed us, from 'Ali b. Zayd b. Jud'an, from al-Qasim b. Rabi'a, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar ﵄, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Indeed, in the quasi-intentional killing — by whip and stick — is one hundred camels in the aggravated form, of which forty are pregnant she-camels with their young in their wombs.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «كُنْتُ أَفْرُكُ الْمَنِيَّ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Hammam b. al-Harith, from 'A'isha ﵂, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I used to scrape semen from the garment of the Messenger of God ﷺ.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: «كُنْتُ أَفْرُكُ الْمَنِيَّ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Hassan informed us, from Hammad b. Salama, from Hammad b. Abi Sulayman, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqama and al-Aswad, from 'A'isha ﵂, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I used to scrape semen from the garment of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he would pray in it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، وَابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، كِلَاهُمَا يُخْبِرُهُ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمَنِيِّ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ قَالَ: " أَمِطْهُ عَنْكَ، قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: بِعُودٍ أَوْ إِذْخِرَةٍ، فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْبُصَاقِ وَالْمُخَاطِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr b. Dinar and Ibn Jurayj, both reporting from 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: he said regarding semen that gets on a garment: “Wipe it away from yourself” — one of them said: “with a stick or an idhkhir (a fragrant rush) — for it is in the position of spittle and mucus.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الثِّقَةُ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَهُ الْمَنِيُّ إِنْ كَانَ ⦗ص: 346⦘ رَطْبًا مَسَحَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ يَابِسًا حَتَّهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فِيهِ
entries.isnad_en: The trustworthy one informed us, from Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said: Mus'ab b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas informed me, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: when semen got on his garment, if it was [p. 346] wet he wiped it off, and if it was dry he scraped it, and then prayed in it.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَهَبَ إِلَى بِئْرِ جَمَلٍ لِحَاجَةٍ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى مَسَحَ يَدَهُ بِجِدَارٍ ثُمَّ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Sulayman b. Yasar, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ went to Bi'r Jamal for a need, then came back, and a man greeted him with salam, and he did not return it until he had wiped his hand on a wall; then he returned the greeting.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Accidental Injuries

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ فِي الْكِتَابُ، الَّذِي كَتَبَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ: «فِي النَّفْسِ مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, from his father ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: in the letter which the Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to 'Amr b. Hazm: “For a life, one hundred camels.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الدِّيَاتِ فِي كِتَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ: «فِي النَّفْسِ مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ» قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: فَقُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ: فِي شَكٍّ أَنْتُمْ مِنْ أَنَّهُ كِتَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: لَا أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, regarding the blood-money in the Prophet's ﷺ letter to 'Amr b. Hazm:
entries.matn_en: “For a life, one hundred camels.” Ibn Jurayj said: I said to 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr: “Are you in any doubt that it is the letter of the Prophet ﷺ?” He said: “No.” Ibn 'Uyayna informed us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, meaning that [same ruling].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، وَعَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، وَعَطَاءٍ، قَالُوا:
entries.matn_ar: أَدْرَكْنَا النَّاسَ عَلَى أَنَّ دِيَةَ الْحُرِّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، فَقَوَّمَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه تِلْكَ الدِّيَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقُرَى أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ أَوِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ، وَدِيَةَ الْحُرَّةِ الْمُسْلِمَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَى خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ، أَوْ سِتَّةُ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ، فَإِنْ كَانَ الَّذِي أَصَابَهَا مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ ⦗ص: 348⦘ فَدِيَتُهَا خَمْسُونَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَدِيَةَ الْأَعْرَابِيَّةِ إِذَا أَصَابَهَا الْأَعْرَابِيُّ خَمْسُونَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، لَا يُكَلَّفُ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ الذَّهَبَ وَلَا الْوَرِقَ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid informed us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Ayyub b. Musa, from Ibn Shihab, and from Makhul and 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: We found the people holding that the blood-money of a free Muslim in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ was one hundred camels. 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ assessed that blood-money for the people of the towns at one thousand dinars or twelve thousand dirhams; and the blood-money of a free Muslim woman, if she is from the people of the towns, is five hundred dinars or six thousand dirhams. If the one who injured her is from the Bedouin [p. 348], her blood-money is fifty camels; and the blood-money of a Bedouin woman, when a Bedouin injures her, is fifty camels; the Bedouin is not burdened [to pay] gold or silver.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى فِي الْجَنِينِ يُقْتَلُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ بِغُرَّةِ عَبْدٍ أَوْ وَلِيدَةٍ، فَقَالَ الَّذِي قَضَى عَلَيْهِ: كَيْفَ أَغْرَمُ مَنْ لَا شَرِبَ وَلَا أَكَلَ وَلَا نَطَقَ وَلَا اسْتَهَلَّ، وَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ يُطَلُّ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّمَا هَذَا مِنْ إِخْوَانِ الْكُهَّانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Ibn al-Musayyib, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ ruled, concerning a fetus killed in its mother's womb, a ghurra (a male or female slave). The one against whom he ruled said: “How can I be made to pay for one who neither drank nor ate nor spoke nor cried out — and the like of that is nullified (yutall)?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “This is only one of the brothers of the soothsayers.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أُذَكِّرُ اللَّهَ امْرَأً سَمِعَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْجَنِينِ شَيْئًا، فَقَامَ حَمَلُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّابِغَةِ فَقَالَ: كُنْتُ بَيْنَ جَارَتَيْنِ لِي، فَضَرَبَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِمِسْطَحٍ فَأَلْقَتْ جَنِينًا مَيِّتًا، فَقَضَى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِغُرَّةٍ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: إِنْ كِدْنَا أَنْ نَقْضِيَ فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا بِرَأْيِنَا
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us, from 'Amr, from Tawus, that 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ said:
entries.matn_en: “I adjure by God any man who heard anything from the Prophet ﷺ concerning the fetus.” Then Hamal b. Malik b. al-Nabigha stood up and said: “I was between two of my neighbor women, and one of them struck the other with a tent peg (mistah), and she miscarried a dead fetus; and the Messenger of God ﷺ ruled a ghurra for it.” 'Umar ﵁ said: “We came close to ruling in a case like this by our own opinion.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَوِّمُ الْإِبِلَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقُرَى أَرْبَعَمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ أَوْ عَدْلَهَا مِنَ الْوَرِقِ، يَقْسِمُهَا عَلَى أَثْمَانِ الْإِبِلِ، فَإِذَا غَلَتْ رَفَعَ فِي قِيمَتِهَا، وَإِذَا هَانَتْ نَقَصَ مِنْ قِيمَتِهَا عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقُرَى الثَّمَنَ مَا كَانَ
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Khalid informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Amr b. Shu'ayb, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to assess the camels for the people of the towns at four hundred dinars or their equivalent in silver, dividing it according to the prices of camels; when they became expensive he raised their valuation, and when they became cheap he lowered their valuation, for the people of the towns, whatever the price was.

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْكِتَابِ الَّذِي كَتَبَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ: «وَفِي الْأَنْفِ إِذَا أُوعِيَ جَدْعًا مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَفِي الْمَأْمُومَةِ ثُلُثُ النَّفْسِ، وَفِي الْجَائِفَةِ مِثْلُهَا، وَفِي الْعَيْنِ خَمْسُونَ، وَفِي الْيَدِ خَمْسُونَ، وَفِي الرِّجْلِ خَمْسُونَ، وَفِي كُلِّ أُصْبُعٍ مِمَّا هُنَالِكَ عَشْرٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَفِي السِّنِّ خَمْسٌ، وَفِي الْمُوضِحَةِ خَمْسٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, from his father, regarding the letter which the Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to 'Amr b. Hazm:
entries.matn_en: “And for the nose, when it is completely cut off, one hundred camels; for the ma'muma (a head wound reaching the membrane of the brain), a third of the life-price; for the ja'ifa (a wound penetrating the torso), the same; for the eye, fifty; for the hand, fifty; for the foot, fifty; for each finger of those, ten camels; for a tooth, five; and for the mudiha (a wound exposing the bone), five.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of Racing, Qasāma, Archery, and the Eclipse
sections.title_ar: وَمِنْ كِتَابِ السَّبَقِ وَالْقَسَامَةِ وَالرَّمْيِ وَالْكُسُوفِ

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ أَبِي نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا سَبَقَ إِلَّا فِي نَصِلٍ أَوْ حَافِرٍ أَوْ خُفٍّ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Nafi' b. Abi Nafi', from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no [permissible stake in] racing except in the arrowhead (nasl), the hoof (hafir), or the foot (khuff).”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا سَبَقَ إِلَّا فِي حَافِرٍ أَوْ خُفٍّ»
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Fudayk informed us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from 'Abbad b. Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra ﵁, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no [permissible stake in] racing except in the hoof or the foot.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَابَقَ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الَّتِي قَدْ أُضْمِرَتْ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar ﵄, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ held a race between the horses that had been trained [lit. made lean].

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ رِجَالٌ مِنْ كُبَرَاءِ قَوْمِهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ وَمُحَيِّصَةَ خَرَجَا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ مِنْ جَهْدٍ أَصَابَهُمَا فَتَفَرَّقَا فِي حَوَائِجِهِمَا، فَأَتَى مُحَيِّصَةُ فَأُخْبِرَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ قَدْ قُتِلَ وَطُرِحَ فِي فَقِيرٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ، فَأَتَى يَهُودَ فَقَالَ: أَنْتُمْ وَاللَّهِ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ، فَقَالُوا: وَاللَّهِ مَا قَتَلْنَاهُ، فَأَقْبَلَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُمْ، فَأَقْبَلَ هُوَ ⦗ص: 350⦘ وَأَخُوهُ حُوَيِّصَةُ، وَهُوَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْهُ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ أَخُو الْمَقْتُولِ فَذَهَبَ مُحَيِّصَةُ يَتَكَلَّمُ وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَانَ بِخَيْبَرَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمُحَيِّصَةَ: «كَبِّرْ كَبِّرْ». يُرِيدُ السِّنَّ، فَتَكَلَّمَ حُوَيِّصَةُ ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمَ مُحَيِّصَةُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِمَّا أَنْ يَدُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ وَإِمَّا أَنْ يُؤْذَنُوا بِحَرْبٍ». فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ذَلِكَ، فَكَتَبُوا: إِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا قَتَلْنَاهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحُوَيِّصَةَ وَمُحَيِّصَةَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ: «تَحْلِفُونَ وَتَسْتَحِقُّونَ دَمَ صَاحِبِكُمْ؟» قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: «فَتَحْلِفُ يَهُودُ». قَالُوا: لَا، لَيْسُوا مُسْلِمَيْنَ، فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِمِائَةِ نَاقَةٍ حَتَّى أُدْخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الدَّارَ، فَقَالَ سَهْلٌ: لَقَدْ رَكَضَنِي مِنْهَا نَاقَةٌ حَمْرَاءُ
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Anas informed us, from Abu Layla 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl, from Sahl b. Abi Hathma, that some of the elders of his people informed him that
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. Sahl b. Abi Hathma and Muhayyisa went out to Khaybar because of hardship that had befallen them, and they separated to attend to their needs. Muhayyisa came and was told that 'Abd Allah b. Sahl had been killed and thrown into a pit or a spring. He went to the Jews and said: “By God, you killed him!” They said: “By God, we did not kill him.” He came back until he reached his people and told them of it. Then he came [p. 350] with his brother Huwayyisa, who was older than he, and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sahl, brother of the slain man. Muhayyisa — who was the one who had been at Khaybar — began to speak, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said to Muhayyisa: “Let the elder [speak], the elder,” meaning in age. So Huwayyisa spoke, then Muhayyisa spoke. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Either they pay the blood-money for your companion, or they will be notified of war.” The Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to them about that, and they wrote back: “By God, we did not kill him.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said to Huwayyisa, Muhayyisa and 'Abd al-Rahman: “Will you swear and thereby claim the blood of your companion?” They said: “No.” He said: “Then shall the Jews swear?” They said: “No, they are not Muslims.” So the Messenger of God ﷺ paid the blood-money from his own funds and sent them a hundred she-camels until they were brought into their house. Sahl said: “A red she-camel among them kicked me.”

sections.title_en: From the Book of the Eclipse

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْقَمَرَ، كَسَفَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِالْبَصْرَةِ، فَخَرَجُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَصَلَّى بِنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ رَكْعَتَانِ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ فَخَطَبَنَا قَالَ: إِنَّمَا صَلَّيْتُ كَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ، لَا يَخْسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلَا لِحَيَاتِهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْهَا كَاسِفًا فَلْيَكُنْ فَزَعُكُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى»
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Muhammad informed us, saying: 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr b. Muhammad b. Hazm narrated to me, from al-Hasan, from Ibn 'Abbas, that
entries.matn_en: the moon was eclipsed while Ibn 'Abbas was in Basra. Ibn 'Abbas came out and led us in two rak'as, in each rak'a two bowings; then he mounted [the pulpit] and gave us a sermon. He said: “I prayed only as I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ pray.” And he said: “The sun and the moon are two of the signs of God; they do not eclipse for anyone's death or anyone's life. So when you see any of them eclipsed, let your recourse be to God Almighty.”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الشَّمْسَ كَسَفَتْ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَوَصَفَتْ صَلَاتَهُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ رَكْعَتَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَهْلٍ نَافِعٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Malik informed us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from 'Amra, from 'A'isha ﵂, from the Prophet ﷺ, that
entries.matn_en: the sun was eclipsed and the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed; she described his prayer as two rak'as, each rak'a with two bowings. Malik informed us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'A'isha, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same. Ibrahim informed us: Abu Sahl Nafi' narrated to me, from Abu Qilaba, from Abu Musa, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same.

sections.title_en: From the Book of Expiations, Vows, and Oaths

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ذَهَبْتُ أَنَا وَعُبَيْدُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، إِلَى عَائِشَةَ وَهِيَ مُعْتَكِفَةٌ فِي ثَبِيرٍ فَسَأَلْنَاهَا عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل: {لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ} [الْبَقَرَة: 225] قَالَتْ: " هُوَ: لَا وَاللَّهِ، بَلَى وَاللَّهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan informed us: 'Amr narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr and I went to 'A'isha while she was in spiritual retreat (i'tikaf) at Thabir, and we asked her about the word of God Almighty: “God will not hold you accountable for what is unintentional in your oaths” [al-Baqara 2:225]. She said: “It is [saying]: ‘No, by God,’ and ‘Yes, by God.’”

entries.label: Report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ وَلَا فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ ابْنُ آدَمَ»
